description: Last survivor of the Kurta clan. Hunter Zodiac. Leads the faction of Queen Oito and Prince Woble. Maintains a status quo through the teaching of Nen.
biography: Kurapika joins the Zodiacs and the expedition in order to approach Tserriednich, the owner of the last Kurta scarlet eyes. He recruits trusted Hunters as royal bodyguards, then accepts Queen Oito's contract and becomes the principal protector of Prince Woble. The Hunters he brings aboard are posted one per prince, and canon numbers those posts by the prince they serve: Kurapika holds zone 14, Melody zone 10 with Kacho, Biscuit zone 13 with Marayam, Basho zone 7 with Luzurus, Izunavi zone 6 with Tyson, Hanzo zone 12 with Momoze until Queen Sevanti moves him to 13. Zone n is room 100n in the catalogue's own numbering.

After Woody's unexplained death, Kurapika identifies the existence of parasitic Nen and exposes the hidden succession war to the guards. He does it in room 1014, gun and Dowsing Chain drawn, questioning the detail one by one: two of them admit they already knew and are not Woble's men. Oito orders him to shoot them where they stand; he has them tied to chairs instead, and what one of them says reframes the five bodies of the day before — Oito is the lowest-ranked queen, so the other seven had each placed a guard around her as an informant. He neutralizes Sayird with Steal Chain, defeats Vincent with Bill and uses Emperor Time to investigate the attacks while keeping Benjamin's soldiers under surveillance.

To break Woble's isolation, he publicly offers Nen lessons to the representatives of the other princes. The classes create a fragile balance of deterrence, but also place room 1014 at the center of Silent Majority's murders and of the princes' diplomatic maneuvers.

Kurapika lends Little Eye to Oito, interrogates suspects with Dowsing Chain and awakens students by temporarily transferring Bill's Erigeron. Every second spent in Emperor Time consumes an hour of his life, a cost that becomes critical when he remains unconscious for nine hours.

On the tenth day, he negotiates a truce with Tubeppa through Longhi and learns that Beyond Netero fathered several children in Kakin. He then uncovers Oito's substitution of the real Woble and organizes a public demonstration intended to keep both babies alive.
abilitiesAndPowers: Kurapika is an elite Hunter, strategist and close-range fighter. His chains combine capture, judgment, healing, divination and ability theft. His scarlet eyes increase his physical capabilities and turn him into a Specialist, but Emperor Time exacts a severe lifespan cost.

nen.overview: Normally a Conjurer, Kurapika becomes a Specialist when his eyes turn scarlet. Emperor Time then grants him perfect efficiency in every Nen category, at the price of one hour of life for each second of activation.
nen.combatProficiency: His five chains are assigned to separate fingers and support combat, investigation and alliances. Chain Jail is restricted to the Phantom Troupe under a lethal vow, while Steal Chain and Stealth Dolphin let him borrow and transfer abilities.

Kurapika and Bill vs. Vincent

description: Magician, Floor Master and elite Transmuter returned from the dead. The real Hisoka is in the Tier 1 casino, while Bonolenov usurps his appearance to fool the mafias.
biography: Chrollo finally accepts Hisoka's duel to the death at the Celestial Tower. From the start, Hisoka understands that his opponent has gathered several abilities especially for this fight. Far from shrinking from Chrollo's explanations and certainty of victory, he becomes ever more enthusiastic when faced with the complexity of the challenge.

Hisoka first confronts the refereeing body manipulated by Black Voice, then the copies animated by Gallery Fake and Order Stamp. He methodically analyzes the rules revealed by Chrollo, decapitates the puppets to neutralize them and tries to identify changes in ability from the disappearance of marks and copies.

When dozens of puppets assault him, Hisoka uses Bungee Gum to move above the arena and transforms severed heads into projectiles reinforced with Shu. He manages to injure Chrollo, but falls into several feints based on Convert Hands and the post-mortem persistence of The Sun and Moon's marks.

Chrollo ultimately launches more than two hundred puppets against him. Hisoka improvises a human hammer with Bungee Gum, but a head explodes in his hand and tears off four of his fingers. Other explosions destroy a leg and throw him into the middle of a final mass of puppets. Unable to escape, he suffocated under the bodies after the final detonation.

Before his death, Hisoka orders Bungee Gum to wrap his heart and lungs and then contract after the fight. His post-mortem Nen revives these organs and resurrects him. He reconstructs a hand, a foot and his face with Bungee Gum and Texture Surprise, recognizing that fighting Chrollo under the conditions Chrollo prepared was a mistake.

Hisoka then changes the rules of his hunt: he will no longer wait for his opponents to choose the place or time. After immobilizing Machi and announcing that he will kill the entire Brigade, he assassinates Kortopi then Shalnark, whose bodies he exposes as a warning.

On the Black Whale, the Brigade and the Xi-Yu and Cha-R families launch a vast search. Information about Hisoka circulates between floors, but several supposed apparitions are just Bonolenov transformed. He neutralizes Zakuro, kills Lynch when she discovers the imposture and accepts in this guise a VVIP pass offered by Hinrigh.

The real Hisoka only appears on the eleventh day, at the Tier 1 casino. He plays SQ-X, even abandons a jackpot and meditates on his desire for single combat to the death. He is unaware that Bonolenov, still disguised as him, has just spotted him and quickly transforms into Owl so as not to be discovered.

On the twelfth day, Hinrigh and Zakuro understand that the so-called Hisoka they met in Tier 3 was an impostor who murdered Lynch. They deduce that this staging was intended to push the mafias to open a route to the higher levels for members of the Brigade, without yet knowing all of Bonolenov's motivations.
abilitiesAndPowers: Hisoka is a first-rate fighter, assassin and tactician. His strength, speed, reflexes, and stamina allow him to compete with the best Nen users. He constantly transforms the terrain into a trap, conceals his ties with In and strengthens his cards with Shu until he can cut through bones or concrete. His psychological reading, his taste for risk and his ability to improvise make his two Hatsu extremely dangerous despite their simple principle.

equipment.name: playing cards
equipment.description: Card game used as a bladed weapon and projectile. Empowered by Shu, the cards can cut through flesh, bone, and even concrete; Hisoka can recall them or change their trajectory with Bungee Gum hidden by In.

nen.overview: Hisoka possesses a powerful and sinister aura. An accomplished transmuter, he precisely controls the shape and lengthening of his aura and also masters Materialization, Emission and probably Reinforcement. He knows post-mortem Nen, exorcism and memory overload phenomena.
nen.combatProficiency: His Ken allows him to survive several explosions from The Sun and Moon. With Shu, his cards and even a severed head become destructive projectiles; with In, he hides Bungee Gum filaments and constructs multi-stage traps. After his death, he gave his aura an automatic command capable of restarting his heart and lungs.

description: Zoldyck assassin and newest member of the Phantom Troupe. He boards the Black Whale under a contract with Hisoka and is confined to Tier 3 with Kalluto.
biography: Illumi joins the Phantom Troupe as member number 11 and boards the Black Whale with Kalluto. He openly explains that Hisoka hired him to kill him, treating the contract as a prenuptial agreement between assassins.

On the fourth day, soldiers find Illumi and Kalluto in Tier 3's vista area. Mizaistom questions him, learns that the Phantom Troupe is aboard and assigns both Zoldycks residential quarters under Zodiac supervision.
abilitiesAndPowers: Illumi is an elite Zoldyck assassin, master of disguise, infiltration and lethal hand-to-hand combat. His needles alter faces, control bodies and can turn crowds into obedient Needle People.

nen.overview: Illumi pours aura into needles used to reshape or control living targets. His control ranges from subtle facial alteration to total domination that sacrifices the victim.
nen.combatProficiency: His perfect Zetsu, assassination training and mass manipulation make him dangerous both alone and through proxies.

description: King of the Kakin Empire. Orchestrated the War of Succession via the Urn of the Seed.
biography: Nasubi announces Kakin's state-sponsored voyage to the Dark Continent and entrusts it to Beyond Netero. Behind the public expedition, he revives the royal succession ritual and informs his fourteen children that only the survivor may inherit the throne.

Aboard the Black Whale, he remains in Tier 1 and refuses to clarify what constitutes withdrawal from the contest. He can perceive the Guardian Spirit Beasts and regards the ship's population as the sacrifice sustaining Kakin's future.

Halkenburg confronts and later shoots him, but a Guardian Spirit Beast catches the bullet. Nasubi insists that a king must accept every life in the nation as part of the succession, while preserving strict neutrality between the princes.
abilitiesAndPowers: As king, Nasubi commands Kakin's institutions and designed the political conditions of the voyage. The succession ritual protects him through an unidentified Guardian Spirit Beast and links the princes to the Seed Urn ceremony.

nen.overview: Nasubi can see Guardian Spirit Beasts, recognizes them as Nen beasts and understands the rules of the parasitic succession ritual. His own natural category is unknown.

description: Eldest son of Unma. Paramilitary leader who manages the application of Martial Law from room 1001.

beyondLineage.evidence: Longhi asks Kurapika to investigate his hypothesis that Beyond fathered one of the fourteen princes.

biography: Before the trip, Benjamin contacts his younger biological brother Tserriednich while subduing an adult lion with his bare hands. He tells him that the only survivor of the trip will become king and promises to eliminate him personally, before strangling the lion without reacting to its claws. He is then officially presented as the First Prince of Kakin, son of the First Queen Unma.

During the festival preceding departure and then the ceremony on board, Benjamin observes his thirteen rivals and considers the succession as a battle royal. His Guardian Spirit Beast appears in a humanoid form bristling with claws and thorns. An argument with Camilla in front of Nasubi triggers his anger, but Balsamilco convinces him not to attack without understanding the parasitic Nen Beasts and the Hunters' strategy.

Benjamin deploys his private soldiers to the other princes to officially protect them, monitor them and identify their abilities, with authorization to kill in self-defense. After Vincent's failure and suicide in Room 1014, he analyzes with Balsamilco the possible powers of Kurapika and Bill, then sends Babimyna as a replacement and Furykov to Nen's lessons.

On the second day, Camilla kills Musse using her postmortem ability, resurrects and enters Room 1001. She shoots Benjamin and Balsamilco, who block the bullets with Ken, before being stopped by Furykov. Musse's death transmits Secret Window to Benjamin via Benjamin Baton, allowing him to monitor Camilla remotely.

Benjamin then follows the rise of Halkenburg thanks to Shikaku's reports. After the trial of Benjamin and Camilla, magistrate Cleapatro orders their confinement under surveillance in the VVIP zone. Benjamin remains calm because Secret Window allows him to know his sister's actions.

On the fourth and fifth days, his men continue their operations: Rihan eliminates the Guardian Beast of Salé-salé, Yushohi then assassinates the prince and Shikaku attempts to use Culdcept against Halkenburg. Halkenburg's collective attack breaks through his defense and Sumidori takes possession of his body. After Shikaku's death, Benjamin also inherits Culdcept.

On the eighth day, Benjamin is briefly captivated by Melody's music. The next day, Balsamilco tells him of Shikaku's suicide. With Kanjidol, they investigate the possibility of a Broadcast attack linked to Halkenburg, then send Vict to gather more information.

On the tenth day, Benjamin and Balsamilco feel another burst of aura and hear Vict being defeated. They conclude that Halkenburg's weapon is produced by his entire group and is impossible to block or dodge. Benjamin confirms with Benjamin Baton that Vict still lives, then has Halkenburg arrested in order to separate him from his supporters.

The same day, Longhi's revelations lead Kurapika to consider that Beyond seeks to bring Benjamin to the throne through the cursed sacrifices placed among the princes' guards. Longhi, however, considers this objective too modest and instead suggests that Beyond is the father of one of the fourteen princes.

On the eleventh day, Fugetsu gives Benjamin a posthumous letter from Kacho. Benjamin's Guardian Beast chases away the evil spirits surrounding Fugetsu. He understands that these are minor parasites attracted by her weakening and estimates that she will probably not survive ten days.

On the twelfth day, Benjamin receives false reports from Balsamilco, whose body is occupied by Halkenburg, concerning the latter's death and funeral. When he feels Halkenburg's aura again, he understands that it is a body-swapping power. He then becomes nauseated and discovers that he has been contaminated by TSK-17.

Furykov admits to having infected Benjamin under Unma's duress while claiming to want to circumvent the curse that Beyond imposed on him at birth. He maintains that the Guardian Beast of Benjamin will be able to transform him after his death into the protective deity of Kakin. Benjamin believes him, proclaims martial law and orders the capture of the princes and the elimination of their non-military guards, while seeking to ensure the succession of his illegitimate child before he dies.

Benjamin then set up his command center at the Tier 2 Justice Office. Faced with Mizaistom, Botobai and Kaiser, he announced that he wanted to bring together the military, judicial and administrative powers. He justifies martial law with an alleged biological conspiracy by Tserriednich and Halkenburg. Mizaistom perceives the opportunistic half-truths in his speech, while Botobai and Kaiser notice his pale complexion and suspect that he himself is infected.
abilitiesAndPowers: First Prince and Deputy Supreme Advisor of the military, Benjamin has considerable political and military influence, martial training, and a personal unit composed of Nen users. Balsamilco considers him a good leader and tactician when he has sufficient information. His charisma inspires absolute loyalty and affection in his men. His strength is superhuman: he can overpower and decapitate an adult lion, as well as lift a dumbbell weighing at least one hundred kilograms with one hand.

equipment.name: Heavy firearm
equipment.description: Weapon more massive than the assault rifles of his guards, carried during the proclamation of martial law.

equipment.name: TSK-17
equipment.description: Biological agent vials that can be loaded into a device hidden in his boot and sprayed at the press of a button.

nen.overview: Benjamin masters Nen. His physical resistance suggests an affinity with Reinforcement, and his Ken allows him to escape several shots that would have injured Furykov unscathed.
nen.combatProficiency: His Ken blocks several bullets at point blank range without the slightest injury. He considers himself clearly superior to Furykov even after the first symptoms of TSK-17 appeared.

guardianSpiritBeast.description: A humanoid beast with sharp claws, spines around the neck, cape-like wings, and a phallic head filled with teeth. Benjamin cannot see his own Beast or those of the other princes and has no control over it.

guardianSpiritBeast.ability: According to Furykov, she could transform Benjamin after his death into the guardian deity of Kakin, capable of protecting future kings and replacing the Urn ceremony. Benjamin would then keep Benjamin Baton. This ability remains unconfirmed.

description: Duazul's eldest daughter. Attempted to murder Benjamin, tried and incarcerated in the VIP Jail of the Supreme Court.

beyondLineage.evidence: Longhi asks Kurapika to investigate his hypothesis that Beyond fathered one of the fourteen princes.

biography: Camilla is officially introduced as the Second Princess of Kakin, daughter of the Second Queen Duazul. She participates in the festival preceding the departure and then in the Black Whale ceremony alongside Benjamin, Zhang Lei and Tubeppa. His Guardian Spirit Beast, an elegant cnidarian-like creature lacking a distinct head, manifests during the ceremony.

At the start of the competition, Camilla asks Nasubi to clarify the notions of survival and abandonment. She claims that she wants everyone to comply with her wishes and that her brothers and sisters voluntarily choose to die for her. An argument breaks out with Benjamin, who judges her to be vain and unworthy of the throne. She then orders her guards to keep Benjamin's soldiers out of her sight and calls for her mother.

In room 1002, Camilla talks about clothes with Duazul before coldly announcing her intention to kill Benjamin and then Halkenburg. She orders her mother to get closer to him. Musse secretly listens to the conversation using his Nen. That same evening, Camilla refuses Kurapika's offer to teach Nen to his guards.

The next day, Camilla leaves her quarters to kill Benjamin. She provokes Musse while holding down Zetsu and gives him the choice between helping her or dying. Musse shoots him three times. After his death, Cat's Name appears, crushes Musse, absorbs his life energy and resurrects Camilla, healing all her wounds.

Camilla claims that Musse has fled, orders the destruction of his belongings then continues on his way with his weapon. She shoots Furykov and Wolfe in the head: Furykov protects himself with Ken, while Wolfe is killed. In room 1001, she empties her magazine on Benjamin and Balsamilco, who block the shots with Ken. Furykov breaks his arm and arrests him.

The following day, Benjamin and Camilla's camps appear before Cleapatro. Camilla's representative invokes self-defense and files a complaint against Benjamin for attempted murder. The two princes are finally confined under surveillance in the VVIP zone, accompanied by their guards and judicial escorts.

On the eighth day, Camilla is briefly captivated by Melody's music. The next day, she remains under surveillance while her Have-Nots prepare their curses against the other princes. Sarahell reminds everyone of their sacrificial duty, tasks Umanma with exorcising any curse against Camilla, and decides to attend Kurapika's classes in order to test a curse on Woble.

On the tenth day, Longhi reveals that Camilla had personally chosen the Have-Nots as guards, which had prevented her half-sister Makaha from being selected and led the latter to discover the cursed children of Beyond. Longhi then asks Kurapika to investigate the hypothesis that Beyond is the father of one of the princes.

On the eleventh day, Camilla receives and reads the posthumous letter that Kacho had intended for her. Later, she gets her nails painted while looking at a tablet. His late choice to send a representative to the second Nen course alerts Kurapika, who suspects a malicious goal and asks Bill to keep Camilla's guards away from Woble.
Around 2 p.m. on the twelfth day, Camilla enjoys her daily after-lunch massage, just before Benjamin declares martial law.
abilitiesAndPowers: As the eldest princess, Camilla has significant political influence. She is clever enough to exploit Musse's disappearance in order to enter Benjamin's house and to organize his legal defense. She concealed her mastery of Nen and gained the absolute loyalty of the Have-Nots by offering them a place in her army. She suffered a broken arm almost without reaction and recovered quickly. A trained shooter, she can hit two heads in rapid succession and empty a double-action revolver at high speed.

equipment.name: Pistolet de Musse
equipment.description: Weapon recovered after Musse's death, used against Furykov, Wolfe, Benjamin and Balsamilco, then confiscated during his arrest.

nen.overview: Camilla is a powerful Nen user. Her knowledge of post-mortem Nen allows her to employ a counterattack ability that makes Benjamin himself reluctant to kill her. His rapid physical recovery could indicate an affinity with Strengthening.

guardianSpiritBeast.description: Elegant cnidarian-like creature with no clearly defined head. Camilla has no control over her. She can take complete control of a target when certain as yet unknown conditions are met.
rules: Cannot fight another Guardian Spirit Beast
Cannot directly attack the host of another Guardian Beast
guardianSpiritBeast.ability: The Beast did not show up when Musse killed Camilla and did not prevent Secret Window from remaining active. It is impossible to determine whether this is from Camilla's Zetsu, her temporary death, or some other condition.

description: Son of Tang Zhao Li. Maintains close ties with the Xi-Yu mafia to accumulate information.

beyondLineage.evidence: Longhi asks Kurapika to investigate his hypothesis that Beyond fathered one of the fourteen princes.

biography: Zhang Lei is introduced as the Third Prince of Kakin, son of Tang Zhao Li. During the festival preceding the departure, he reaffirms his desire to win the succession competition. His Guardian Spirit Beast appears the next day: a large, floating dharmachakra-like wheel, surrounded by flames and with a minimalist face.

During the ceremony, Zhang Lei asks Nasubi about the conditions for becoming king. Upon learning that Woble's guards had been decimated, he was surprised that the infant had been targeted first and considered a maneuver intended to hide the identity of the culprit. He then welcomes the soldier sent by Benjamin as an opportunity to gain information about the Beasts of Nen.

Zhang Lei is one of the three princes who call room 1014 after Kurapika's announcement. Shimanu chooses his appeal, deeming it reasonable, tolerant but too proud to wait. Zhang Lei invites Kurapika, Oito and Woble to Room 1003 to exchange information about Nen, then entrusts Sakata and Hashito to Woble's protection until the banquet on the eighth day.

He agrees to send Tenftory to Nen's lessons with the mission of observing Kurapika's contacts. At the same time, his alliance with the Xi-Yu mafia family is revealed. This relationship provides him with an information network and a deterrent force against superior princes.

On the third day, a coin bearing the number 1 falls from the mouth of its Guardian Beast. Coventoba gives it to him while hiding that he had already kept an identical piece produced the day before. Zhang Lei does not perceive the dark aura of the object and begins to study its operation with his guards.

On the eighth day, Zhang Lei is briefly captivated by Melody's music. At the tenth, Tenftory returns from classes with his aura pores open and can finally see the Guardian Beast. Zhang Lei rewards him with two coins and promises him more benefits when he has accumulated enough. Coventoba then discovers that his own coin has gone from value 1 to 10.

Zhang Lei concludes that the coins must be distributed and that they will probably be more useful after he ascends the throne than during the war. So he decides to win without their direct help and consults Onior Longbao, leader of the Xi-Yu, for information on Nen, the Guardian Beasts, and how Nasubi won his own succession.

He personally goes to the Justice Bureau to meet Melody, show her his respect, ask for a new performance and offer her a play. Melody listens to her heart but cannot establish that it is responsible for the manipulations she suspects around Kaiser.

On the eleventh day, Zhang Lei received Kacho's posthumous letter. He then gathers his guards around the coins, one of which has reached the value 10, and asks Kurapika again. Experiments show that the value increases after ten days, that the illustration on the reverse depends on the owner and that any transfer resets the value to 1.

Kurapika speculates that the coins accumulate Nen, could awaken a non-user after about 180 days, and cause an ability to appear after 640 days. He also suspects a pseudo-coercive Manipulation effect reinforcing loyalty towards Zhang Lei, but keeps this hypothesis secret from Coventoba. Zhang Lei appreciates that this cumulative power reflects his forward-looking temperament.

Zhang Lei maintains his support for Woble in exchange for Kurapika's information, while implicitly reminding him that they are not equals. He spends the rest of the day examining his pieces. The next day, Tenftory returns to Nen's classes and Slakka asks to join as well.

Just before the proclamation of martial law on the twelfth day, Zhang Lei leaves Tier 1 via a gateway located in Onior's residence and reaches Tier 2. Benjamin orders his reconnaissance teams to find him, assuming that he is seeking refuge with Justice or the mafia.
abilitiesAndPowers: As one of the eldest princes, Zhang Lei has significant political influence, numerous guards, and the support of the Xi-Yu mafia family. It favors negotiation, the accumulation of information, rewards and long-term alliances.

equipment.name: Nen Coins
equipment.description: Twelve pieces were produced by his Guardian Beast. The first was stolen by Coventoba, two were offered to Tenftory, one to Melody and one to Kurapika, leaving at most seven pieces for Zhang Lei. Their value returns to 1 when they change ownership.

guardianSpiritBeast.description: A floating beast shaped like an eight-branched dharmachakra, rimmed with black flames and featuring a simple face at its center. She appears slightly conscious and usually stays close to Zhang Lei, who cannot see or control her.
rules: Cannot fight another Guardian Spirit Beast
Cannot directly attack the host of another Guardian Beast
guardianSpiritBeast.ability: It almost certainly produces one coin per day and has several effects subject to different conditions. A coin is born with the value 1, increases to 10 after ten days and could multiply its value by ten every ten days. Its reverse depicts the Beast when owned by Zhang Lei and Zhang Lei when offered. Any transfer causes an aura surge and resets the value to 1. According to Kurapika, the coins store Nen, could awaken a non-user after 180 days, give rise to an ability after 640 days, and induce pseudo-coercive loyalty to Zhang Lei. These effects remain hypothetical.

description: Fourth Prince of Kakin and son of Unma. Collector of Scarlet Eyes, sadistic murderer and prodigious Nen genius turned Specialist.

beyondLineage.evidence: Longhi asks Kurapika to investigate his hypothesis that Beyond fathered one of the fourteen princes.

biography: Mizaistom reveals to Kurapika that Tserriednich is the owner of a large collection of Scarlet Eyes. This information pushes Kurapika to join the Zodiacs and embark for the Dark Continent in order to approach him.

Tserriednich first appears in one of his hotels, where he murders and dismembers young women he considers uneducated in order to produce a macabre art form. Benjamin then informs him that the only surviving prince from the journey will become king; Tserriednich is delighted to be able to eliminate his brothers and sisters.

After confirming his guards' qualification for the Hunter Exam, he participates in the Urn of Succession ceremony. Still ignoring Nen, he perceives neither the fairy nor the egg transmitted to him. During the departure ceremonies, he displays his belief in becoming king and silently calls the crowd an ignorant mass.

On board, Tubeppa offers him an alliance against their three elders. He approves of her judgment but inwardly wonders if she will still be alive a week later. Kurapika's announcement regarding the Beasts of Nen leads him to question Theta, then demand that she teach him Nen immediately.

Within hours, Tserriednich learns to visualize the aura and begins Gyo, revealing a talent that terrifies Theta. When she tries to slow down her learning, her guardian Spirit Beast detects her lies and marks her. The creature then interrupts Queen Oito's surveillance by neutralizing the cockroach controlled by Little Eye.

After just a few days, his water test causes the leaf to wilt, the water to boil and produce a putrid odor: he is identified as a Specialist with a particularly sinister nature. He quickly masters Ten, Ren and the closure of his aura nodes, while unconsciously materializing a second Beast of Nen linked to his own power.

During a Zetsu exercise, he discovers Parallel Future: by closing his eyes, he instantly sees the next ten seconds, then can act differently while the others continue to perceive the predicted scene. He thus survives Theta's attempted execution, dodges her shot and hides the incident from his guards.

After being captivated by Melody's music, he realizes that another of Nen's abilities is at work and seeks to recruit her. He theorizes his own power and decides to shorten the activation time of his Zetsu as much as possible, convinced that perfect mastery will allow him to dominate the succession and then the world.

During Theta's rest, he continues his training with Salkov. In one week, he already applies the four fundamental exercises and drops below ten seconds to activate Zetsu, then reaches 3.496 seconds on the eleventh day, while running and using his phone.

At the same time, her private troop is looking for Morena Prudo and the Heil-Ly in Tier 3. Her former comrades from the Military Academy understand that her lack of reaction comes from her fascination with Nen and try to protect Borksen, who was finally kidnapped by the Heil-Ly.

Tserriednich refuses Kacho's posthumous letter and orders it thrown out. On the twelfth day, Benjamin, contaminated by TSK-17, proclaimed martial law and publicly accused Tserriednich of having conspired with Halkenburg to commit a biological attack.
abilitiesAndPowers: As one of the eldest princes of Kakin, Tserriednich has considerable political influence, immense funds, a luxurious hotel, a bodyguard, and a personal army. Extremely intelligent and cultured, he masters many scientific, philosophical and artistic fields. Theta believes that his ability to consider multiple scenarios simultaneously exceeds his own, even in a field as new to him as Nen. His visualization, concentration and learning speed are exceptional.

nen.overview: Tserriednich is a Nen genius. In less than a day, he learns to slightly control his aura and the basics of Gyo. In a few days, he achieved great mastery of Ten and Ren, closed his aura nodes on the first try, performed a perfect Zetsu for an hour on his third attempt and unconsciously developed a complete ability as well as a personal Nen Beast.
nen.waterDivination: The leaf withers as the water boils and emits a putrid odor, revealing a Specialist with an extremely sinister aura.
nen.combatProficiency: He possesses a large amount of aura and reduces his Zetsu activation time from over ten seconds to 3.496 seconds in a matter of days. Parallel Future notably allows him to escape a fatal shot from Theta.

guardianSpiritBeast.description: Equine beast with a woman's head, equipped with arms with long nails, stiletto heels, a flail tail and an extendable neck. Its face can open to reveal a second head and oral appendages. Like the other Urn Beasts, Tserriednich cannot see or control it. She can pass through walls and disappears when he loses his aura with Zetsu.
rules: Cannot fight another Guardian Spirit Beast
Cannot directly attack the host of another Guardian Beast
Judge the answers given to Tserriednich's questions
guardianSpiritBeast.ability: When a person lies to Tserriednich, the Beast inflicts a cut on them. A second lie turns the mark into an infected wound and prompts a verbal warning: a third lie would change the victim into something inhuman. Salkov assumes that it offers several chances to traitors in order to transform them into pawns. She can also neutralize a manipulated creature, such as the cockroach controlled by Oito with Little Eye.

description: Fifth Princess of Kakin and daughter of Duazul. A methodical scientist, she favors alliances and the analysis of Nen's abilities.

beyondLineage.evidence: Longhi asks Kurapika to investigate his hypothesis that Beyond fathered one of the fourteen princes.

biography: Tubeppa is shown in a laboratory, wearing protective gear and handling chemicals. At the festival before departure, she joins the other princes and Beyond Netero on stage, convinced that she will become the next ruler of Kakin.

At the departure ceremony, she proposes an alliance to Tserriednich. She believes that the succession essentially pits the first five princes against each other and considers their three elders repugnant. Tserriednich approves of her criticism, but inwardly doubts that she will survive until their next meeting.

After Kurapika's announcement about the Beasts of Nen, Tubeppa understands that he is trying to create an impasse. She orders Maor to obtain information and offers a truce to Room 1014 in exchange for information. At the same time, she monitors Butch, the spy sent by Benjamin.

Tubeppa sends Maor and Longhi to Nen's lessons and asks them to form an alliance with Kurapika within two weeks, even if it means including Woble in the deal. On the seventh day, she is briefly captivated by Melody's flute performance.

After the report from her guards, she accepts the continuation of the lessons and easily deduces the death of Salé-salé from his absence at the banquet and his usual behavior. She is looking to determine if Nen is involved and wants to make a list of abilities that could influence the development of her guards. Aware that Maor would not be enough against a Nen attack, she concludes that she needs Kurapika.

Longhi secretly establishes a truce contract with Kurapika using the Moonlight Act. The agreement protects Tubeppa, Woble, their queens and their guards until the fifteenth day, provides for its renewal under conditions and obliges the Woble camp to identify Beyond's possible child among the princes.

Maor informs Tubeppa that Kurapika accepts the alliance on the condition that Oito and Woble accompany him to room 1005 and that Zhang Lei's guards witness the exchanges. Tubeppa welcomes these conditions and says she would even accept Woble living with her.

Noting Tserriednich's disinterest and the threat of Benjamin's soldiers, Tubeppa hopes that his rapprochement with Zhang Lei will divert their attention. Closing the truce causes her Guardian Spirit Beast to appear behind her, suggesting that its activation depends on established collaboration.
On the eleventh day, Tubeppa receives and reads Kacho's posthumous letter under Rihan's supervision. She is then seen deep in thought in front of her laptop.
abilitiesAndPowers: Tubeppa had significant political influence and wealth, although less than that of the older princes. An experienced scientist, she masters several branches of experimental science as well as advanced mathematics. His analytical intelligence allows him to quickly deduce Salé-salé's death and strategize carefully around Nen, alliances, and Benjamin's spies.

guardianSpiritBeast.description: Large toad-like creature, covered in growths and with spoked wheels for feet. Extremely cautious, she avoids appearing in the presence of Benjamin's soldiers. Tubeppa is unaware of its existence, cannot control it and does not perceive it.

description: Sixth Princess of Kakin and daughter of Katrono. Author of the Book of Tyson, she seeks to win succession through her doctrine of love.

beyondLineage.evidence: Longhi asks Kurapika to investigate his hypothesis that Beyond fathered one of the fourteen princes.

biography: Tyson hires Izunavi as his personal guard for the trip to the Dark Continent. During the ceremony preceding departure, she boards, laughing at the idea of ​​winning the war of succession, and joins her family on the first deck of the Black Whale.

His Guardian Spirit Beast quickly becomes active and its small creatures enter Woble's room on the first day. After Kurapika's announcement, Tyson understands that the Beasts are from the Urn ceremony and happily imagines his own "fairies" spreading love throughout the ship.

She distributes copies of the Book of Tyson to her guards, which she presents as a means of establishing world peace. She forgives Izunavi for not having read it yet, saying that everyone progresses at their own pace, while Giuliano claims that the work is already transforming his heart.

On the third day, Tyson preaches that love will always triumph, recites passages inspired by famous songs and leads his employees in a series of exercises while his Beast produces new Eye-wogs. Unlike several princes, she does not send any guards to follow Kurapika's Nen lessons.

During the banquet on the eighth day, she organizes musical performances by all her guards: her army sings a cappella and Izunavi with Giuliano plays rock. She is then briefly captivated by Melody's flute.

On the tenth day, she prepares a surprise party and cake for Giuliano herself, knowing that his contract will end before his birthday. His guards then play Tyson's favorite characters; touched by his attention, Giuliano willingly participates in the game.

Izunavi notices that reading the Book makes Giuliano unusually calm and suspects a connection to the Guardian Beast. He plans to influence Nasubi in order to stop the succession. Tyson explains that he distributed his book to younger princes and their mothers, and demanded that a copy be given to the king as a condition of his participation.

Tyson reveals that she initially did not want to compete, but that her mother Katrono, humiliated by the looks of the other queens and convinced that she would not have grandchildren, wanted revenge. Tyson claims to only fight with the power of love and promises to ask his mother to have Nasubi read her book at the next banquet.

On the eleventh day, Fugetsu brings him Kacho's posthumous letter. Tyson greets the news with surprised sadness, reads the message, then later sings passages from his book in front of Giuliano and two other guards.
abilitiesAndPowers: Tyson has the wealth and political influence associated with his rank, although they remain less than those of his elders. Her main lever is ideological: she rallies those around her to a doctrine centered on love, stages her guards and spreads her book to the other princes, their mothers and potentially the king.

equipment.name: Livre de Tyson
equipment.description: Doctrinal text whose first chapter is entitled “Love will always triumph”. Tyson distributes it to his guards and younger princes. Degree of reading determines the happiness granted by the Eye-wogs, while breaking the single taboo of its teachings triggers severe punishment.

guardianSpiritBeast.description: Heart-shaped creature with four small wings and a large central eye. She lays small Nen Beasts called Eye-wogs through a lower opening: tadpoles with ocular heads, prehensile hands and flexible tails. Tyson cannot see or control his Beast.

description: Seventh Prince of Kakin and son of Duazul. Godfather of the Cha-R mafia family, he displays a relaxed attitude but is cautious and insightful.

beyondLineage.evidence: Longhi asks Kurapika to investigate his hypothesis that Beyond fathered one of the fourteen princes.

biography: Luzurus is first mentioned when Theta reports to Tserriednich that all of her guards have failed the Hunter Exam. He then appears smoking a hookah in a room filled with bottles. Basho responds to his anonymous ad and becomes his guard for the expedition.

During the ceremonies preceding departure, Luzurus is clearly less enthusiastic than his brothers and sisters. After Kurapika's announcement, his three Hunter guards explain Nen to him. He maintains his plan to target Tubeppa first, believing that Nen could allow him to dominate the succession if his rivals ignore him.

Luzurus discovers Clean Leaf with Basho, a legal substance intended for heavy smokers. He immediately considered using it to rehabilitate drug addicts and publishing the results of a clinical trial, while recognizing the obstacles posed by military drug control.

He agrees to send his men to Kurapika's lessons and chooses Satobi. His ties to the Cha-R family, one of the three major Kakin mafias on board, are then revealed. On the eighth day, he is briefly captivated by Melody's music.

On the ninth day, Luzurus and his guards hear the gunshot of Shikaku, whose body occupied by Sumidori commits suicide in front of room 1007. They come out armed and examine the scene. Luzurus rejects the idea that his mother Duazul may have organized the incident, as she does not actively support any of her children.

Melody, Kacho, and Kaiser then suspect his Guardian Beast of having trapped Fugetsu, whose compulsive use of Magical Worm is quickly depleting his aura. They devise a plan to knock out Luzurus, put him through the Fugetsu Tunnel, and kill him in a lifeboat by faking an accidental overdose.

Fugetsu and the Justice agents go to room 1007 under the pretext of delivering Kacho's posthumous letter. Luzurus offers his condolences, reads the message then entrusts it to Kaiser, believing that its contents constitute a political bomb intended to provoke investigations against the princes.

Luzurus suspects that each recipient received a different letter and refuses to be recklessly drawn against Tserriednich. Kaiser notes that the prince is more cautious and suspicious than expected, but considers the operation successful since room 1007 is now marked by Magical Worm.
Later, Luzurus watches a movie in his room with Rice and Basho. On the twelfth day, Benjamin proclaimed martial law and ordered his soldiers to search for Luzurus and Zhang Lei as a priority.
abilitiesAndPowers: Luzurus benefits from the wealth and influence of a prince, although they remain inferior to those of his elders. Godfather of Cha-R, he also has a powerful mafia network. Beneath his relaxed manner, he appears pragmatic and insightful: he quickly considers medical applications for Clean Leaf and detects the manipulative dimension of the letter attributed to Kacho.

equipment.name: Hookah and Clean Leaf
equipment.description: Luzurus uses various substances and tests Clean Leaf with Basho, a legal product likely to help heavy smokers and people addicted to other drugs.

guardianSpiritBeast.description: Huge centipede-like creature with an insect-like head, small wings near its antennae, and a massive body. Luzurus can neither see nor control her.

guardianSpiritBeast.ability: The Beast sets traps by materializing his target's desire as bait, then triggers pseudo-coercive Manipulation once this desire is satisfied. Melody and Kacho suspect that she stung Fugetsu, making her believe she could use Magical Worm multiple times a day and causing an addiction that fatally exhausts her. This responsibility is, however, not confirmed; if she were, the trap would likely circumvent the ban on directly attacking another prince.

description: Eighth Prince of Kakin and son of Swinko-swinko. An irresponsible party animal, he influenced those around him with the smoke of his Guardian Beast before his assassination.

beyondLineage.evidence: Longhi asks Kurapika to investigate his hypothesis that Beyond fathered one of the fourteen princes.

biography: Salé-salé is presented surrounded by four women in light outfits. During the ceremonies preceding departure, he joyfully greets the crowd then joins the Black Whale, where Benjamin assigns him a soldier responsible for both protecting him and spying on him.

Back in room 1008, he throws a loud party with several women, with food, alcohol and money scattered on the floor. Above him, his spherical Guardian Spirit Beast releases white smoke and produces small copies of itself.

His mother Swinko-swinko comes to reproach him for his carelessness and warns him that he risks being the first prince eliminated. Salé-salé replies that he intends to “change the world” thanks to a performance planned at the following banquet.

He accepts Kurapika's offer of Nen lessons but only sends Mushaho, captain of his mother's guards. Salé-salé plans to broadcast his rap performance over the public address system, while Rihan methodically studies his Beast in order to prepare Predator.

Rihan discovers that smoke gradually increases sympathy towards Salty and that a sufficiently exposed person develops a copy capable of contaminating other targets. After seventy hours of observation on Koroabde, he obtained the information necessary to make Predator particularly effective.

Predator first devours the copy placed above Koroabde, who immediately forgets his compliments, then swallows the main Guardian Beast, unable to defend itself. Rihan then asks to be replaced by Yushohi.

On the night of the sixth day, Yushohi assassinates Salé-salé using Stand by Me. The women present try in vain to resuscitate him. His death was concealed from the public and his absence from the banquet was officially attributed to illness.

In the following days, several characters talk about his death or seek to verify the circumstances. Tubeppa deduces this from his absence and investigates Nen's involvement. His corpse is finally depicted in chapter 413.
abilitiesAndPowers: Salé-salé possessed the wealth and political influence of a prince, without reaching the level of his elders. Very sure of his talents as a rapper, which he thought could change the world, he however had no known personal aptitude for Nen and was entirely dependent on his Guardian Beast, without even knowing of its existence.

guardianSpiritBeast.description: Large sphere covered with numerous mouths, linked to the libido of Salé-salé and present almost all day long, except in three unknown situations. It emits white aura smoke and spawns small copies. Salé-salé could neither see nor control her.

guardianSpiritBeast.ability: The smoke exerts a weakly coercive Manipulation which increases benevolence towards Salé-salé. Its average radius is seven meters and varies with its stress. A favorable target develops copy in about eight hours, compared to seventy hours for someone with no loyalty. Each clone in turn spreads the smoke within a two-meter radius, transforming the victims into vectors. Holding your breath or dispersing the smoke is enough to avoid contamination. Despite its potential for massive dictatorship, the Beast has no defenses of its own and was devoured by Predator.

description: Ninth Prince of Kakin, biological son of Unma adopted by Duazul. A pacifist turned fighter, his body is dead but his soul remains active in that of Balsamilco.

biography: Halkenburg is introduced as the Ninth Prince, officially the son of Duazul but biologically born to Unma before being adopted. A brilliant student at Miwal University, physicist, world-class archer and public critic of the monarchy, he initially refuses to participate in a fratricidal war.

Before the trip, Kurapika mistakenly believes he is responding to an ad from Halkenburg, whose popularity would have attracted assassins. On board, the prince reaffirms to Nasubi that he does not want the throne at the price of blood, but his father replies that he is free to act as he wishes.

His beast acts long before he knows he has one: back in room 1009 on the first days, he finds all eleven of his bodyguards unconscious on the floor and no cause he can see. Nothing in the room explains it, and the archive only reads it backwards — the ability that knocked them out is the one he will awaken twenty chapters later, and it runs on the aura of the followers it marks.

After Momoze's death, Halkenburg gathered his supporters for a minute of silence. Their shared will unleashes an immense wave of aura and his Guardian Beast marks their hands with a pinion, increasing their collective aura to a level that terrifies Shikaku.

Halkenburg tried for several days to deliver a petition to Nasubi. On the sixth day, he finally forced the passage with his men, demanded an end to the succession and shot the king. The Beast of Nasubi stops the bullet; when he turns the weapon on himself, his own Guardian Beast also prevents his suicide.

Nasubi explains to him that the survival of the country takes precedence over that of the princes and that he will have to become king before he can abolish the monarchy. Halkenburg then fully accepts the fight and awakens Grimmel the Dissonance, an ability powered by the will and aura of his marked followers.

Facing Shikaku, he materializes an arc of aura and shoots an arrow that passes through Culdcept and all defenses. The attack randomly transfers Sumidori's soul into Shikaku's body. Halkenburg then experiments to understand the relationship between the two consciousnesses and uses the possessed body to simulate Shikaku's suicide.

On the tenth day, Vict tries to attack him but a new arrow hits him. Benjamin and Balsamilco understand that the weapon is impossible to block or dodge and that any sufficiently loyal follower can fuel the collective aura, even if they are not part of their guard.

Balsamilco prepares TSK-17 to assassinate Halkenburg at the hospital. Halkenburg anticipates the operation and hits him with his arrow through a wall, this time transferring his own soul into Balsamilco's body. His original body, infected, is taken to the hospital while he poses as his killer.

Halkenburg deduces that if his body dies first, Balsamilco's soul will take priority again in his own body. He therefore plans to swallow a sleeping pill just before his original shell dies, in order to have about ten hours to make his next move.

His body died on the morning of the twelfth day. From Balsamilco's body, Halkenburg obtained permission from Benjamin to organize a solemn funeral procession, accompanied by his supporters and announced to the entire ship. His corpse is transferred from Tier 3 to the Tier 1 morgue, while his soul secretly continues the war of succession.

After the proclamation of martial law, Benjamin comes to suspect that Balsamilco is controlled and that the collective power of Halkenburg may override the ordinary rules of priority of Manipulation. The current situation therefore distinguishes a deceased royal body from a still living consciousness.
abilitiesAndPowers: Halkenburg has exceptional academic intelligence: admitted at the age of fifteen to the most prestigious university in the world, he is notably an expert in physics. A silver medalist at the World Archery Championships, he is one of the best known archers. His charisma brings together many supporters and his strategic mastery is evident in his petitions, his experiments on soul transfer and his infiltration of Benjamin's camp.

nen.combatProficiency: The collective aura forms an armor deemed invincible and an arrow impossible to block or dodge. Activation appears to require Halkenburg to be willing to risk his life with every shot.

When the bearers gather around Halkenburg and share the same will, they will have reached the peak of collective abilities. biography: Kacho is introduced as the Tenth Princess, twin of Fugetsu and daughter of Seiko. She posts an anonymous ad to recruit guards and hires Melody. During the departure ceremonies, the two sisters appear together and hold hands.

At the end of the inaugural banquet, Kacho asks Fugetsu to form an alliance and promises to save her if she wins. She then adopts a temperamental attitude in front of her staff, but Melody hears in her heartbeat that this spoiled personality is an act intended to cover up her true intentions.

Kacho agrees to send Loberry and Yuri to Kurapika's Nen lessons. After the Silent Majority incident involving Loberry, an investigator monitors room 1010 for seventy-two hours. Kacho maintains her facade while her mother is questioned.

On the third day, Fugetsu secretly reaches Kacho's bed thanks to Magical Worm. Kacho immediately hides her sister and Melody understands that she must explain Nen to her. The princess then acquires a Mosquitone in order to transmit instructions to Melody in Morse code while simulating ordinary conversations.

She obtains permission from Seiko to play the glassharmonica with Fugetsu during the Sunday banquet, accompanied by Melody's flute. Under the cover of rehearsals, Kacho prepares an escape with Melody and Keeney while the music temporarily neutralizes the occupants of the upper floors.

On the eighth day, Melody captivates the audience and Keeney leads the twins to a canoe. As soon as they leave the Black Whale, spectral hands attack the boat. Kacho understands that the ceremony punishes any escape and orders Fugetsu to open Magical Worm to return on board.

Fugetsu enters the tunnel, but Kacho remains in the boat and dies. Without You immediately activates, takes on his appearance and personality then joins Fugetsu through the door. The copy is indistinguishable from the original and retains his memories, his intelligence and his determination.

At the Justice Bureau, Kacho's copy understands his likely nature as a resurrected Guardian Beast and decides to keep the truth a secret to protect Fugetsu. Along with Melody and Kaiser, she plans to use the princes' recital requests to trick or eliminate them.

When Fugetsu begins compulsively using Magical Worm and becomes weaker, Kacho discovers a mark on his shoulder blade. She suspects the Beast of Luzurus and hatches a plan to knock him out, transport him in a dinghy through the tunnel, and fake a fatal overdose.

Kacho writes, with information from Kaiser, different posthumous letters for each prince. Fugetsu distributes them in order to mark their rooms with Magical Worm and spread politically explosive information. Luzurus' cautious attitude, however, complicates their operation.

Kacho then watches over Fugetsu in the infirmary. On the morning of the twelfth day, she fears that her own existence will consume her sister's aura, but Melody reminds her that Fugetsu needs her and would likely not survive without her protection.
abilitiesAndPowers: Kacho has little real political influence, but has remarkable talent as an actress: she maintains a capricious personality while communicating secretly, only her heartbeat allowing Melody to detect the lie. Foresighted and strategic, she knows Morse code, plays the glassharmonica and designs several complex operations with Melody and Kaiser.

biography: Fugetsu is introduced as the Eleventh Princess, twin of Kacho and daughter of Seiko. During departure ceremonies, she stays alongside her sister. Kacho offers him an alliance and claims to want to kill their rivals before asking Nasubi to spare him; Fugetsu shyly accepts without immediately perceiving that this hardness is a protective facade.

She responds to Kurapika's offer by sending her maids Illardia and Ladiolus to Nen's lessons. The following night, unable to sleep, she discovers on the wall a small door identical to that of a playground from their childhood. She goes through the tunnel and comes out straight into Kacho's bed.

Fugetsu experiments to understand this “magic”. The door refuses to open in the morning but reappears at night. On the fourth day, an attempt leads her alone to Tier 3, where the Hunters find her and place her under protection at the central police station. She refuses to speak without her sister.

Taken back to her room under constant surveillance, Fugetsu continues her tests and practices the glassharmonica. Yushohi understands that her Beast probably allows translocation and notes that her involuntary departure removed her from Stand by Me.

On the eighth day, Fugetsu participates with Kacho and Melody in the escape plan. Shielded from the music by headphones, the twins follow Keeney to a boat and leave the ship. Spectral hands immediately attack them, revealing that the ceremony condemns any attempt to escape.

Fugetsu opens Magical Worm and enters the tunnel. Kacho closes the door behind her and dies in the boat, but Without You takes her appearance and joins Fugetsu. Unaware of the substitution, Fugetsu returns with the copy to room 1011.

Placed in the Bureau of Justice as a protected witness, Fugetsu discovers that she can apparently use Magical Worm several times a day and open the return door on her own. She becomes euphoric and compulsive, claiming to want to protect Kacho, but quickly becomes exhausted and eventually loses consciousness.

Melody perceives a dark presence around her, many spirits and an aura as weak as in Zetsu. A puncture-like mark appears on his shoulder blade. Melody and Kacho suspect a multi-stage enemy ability, possibly Luzurus's Guardian Beast trap, but this origin remains unconfirmed.

To prepare for the elimination of Luzurus and expand the destinations accessible to Magical Worm, Fugetsu distributes Kacho's posthumous letters to the princes of Tier 1 under escort from the Ministry of Justice. Benjamin and Basho temporarily repel the spirits surrounding her, but Benjamin estimates that she will not survive ten days in this state.

Visiting room 1007 marks it as Magical Worm's future destination. The plan involves putting Luzurus to sleep with Melody's music, transporting him into the tunnel and then taking him out of the ship so that the Inheritance Curse will kill him.

After her tour, Fugetsu collapses and remains asleep in the infirmary for the remainder of the eleventh day and then the beginning of the twelfth. Kacho watches over her while Melody insists on the need to let her recover and find an exorcist quickly.
abilitiesAndPowers: Fugetsu has virtually no political influence, but demonstrates a true analytical mind: without knowing Nen, she formulates hypotheses and organizes experiments to understand Magical Worm. Like Kacho, she can play the glassharmonica. Despite her anxious temperament, she traverses several levels of the ship alone and actively participates in the plan to save her sister.

biography: Momoze first appears sewing. She is one of six princes who posted an anonymous announcement and hires Hanzo as a guard for the expedition. During the festival preceding the trip, she greets the crowd then joins the Black Whale banquet near her younger brother Marayam.

On the first day, his Guardian Spirit Beast enters room 1014 and takes control of Sayird. He kills Kurton and tries to attack the other guards before being overpowered by Kurapika, without Momoze knowing that his aura is fueling the attack.

After the ceremony, Sevanti transfers almost the entire team from Momoze to Marayam, leaving him with only six guards. Momoze reassures his staff and calmly accepts the decision, while internally judging that the fear of his mother and brother demonstrates that Marayam is not worthy to become king.

Consuming his Beast's aura causes intense fatigue. Momoze allows two guards to rest, then falls asleep around four p.m. While she sleeps, her Guardian Beast disappears due to lack of energy, leaving her completely vulnerable.

Tuffdy, one of his own guards, then enters the room and strangles him. Oito sees the murder thanks to the cockroach controlled by Little Eye, but the alert given to room 1012 comes too late. The six guards are then arrested for collusion and court-martialed.

Kurapika understands that Momoze's Beast was probably one of the ones that attacked Woble and that its use had exhausted the princess. Hanzo, consumed by guilt, identifies Tuffdy among the two guards on break then uses Hanzo Skill 4 to infiltrate his cell, obtain his confession and strangle him.

The next day, Nasubi mourns in front of Momoze's body in one of the fourteen funeral capsules arranged around a mysterious room. He claims that it becomes the foundation of the great Tree of Kakin and that it shines even more after his death.

Its disappearance visibly strengthens the Guardian Beast of Marayam. Halkenburg organizes a minute of silence in his memory and mourns his death, an event which triggers the immense collective aura of his supporters and precipitates his decision to confront Nasubi. Momoze's corpse is depicted again in chapter 413.
abilitiesAndPowers: Due to his young rank, Momoze possessed virtually no political influence. She nevertheless appeared calm, caring and lucid: she reassured her staff after the transfer of her guards, thanked those who refused to rest and severely analyzed the fear of her mother and Marayam. She loved sewing and knitting.
