biography: Marayam first appears while observing three hamsters in a cage. He posts an anonymous ad and hires Biscuit Krueger as a guard. During the festival preceding the trip, he takes his cage on stage and then stays with his mother Sevanti and his sister Momoze at the Black Whale banquet.

On the first day, his Guardian Spirit Beast, still graceful and like a dragon on legs, explores room 1014 with several other creatures. This intrusion contributes to Kurapika's emergency announcement about the Beasts of Nen.

Sevanti then leads Marayam to Momoze's room and transfers almost all of his sister's team to him, including Hanzo and Vergei, citing his fear and the need to better protect him. Marayam clutches his clothes as the employees reluctantly obey.

In room 1013, his Beast gradually grows while Marayam eats, plays with his toy cars and experiences the anxiety of those around him. Oito briefly observes him thanks to Little Eye's cockroach. Marayam sends Barrigen and Belerainte to follow Kurapika's Nen lessons; Barrigen is killed there by Silent Majority.

After Momoze's death, which Marayam seems to feel despite the secrecy, the Beast becomes gigantic, covered in thorns and almost ten times taller than him in a seated position. Hanzo and Biscuit conclude that the child's fear, trauma, and stress directly transform their appearance.

When Hanzo returns after avenging Momoze, he finds an empty room 1013 and a smaller but much more menacing version of the Beast, equipped with thorny vines ending in mouths. At the same time, Vergei calls from a seemingly normal room where Marayam and Sevanti are still playing.

Kurapika understands that the real Room 1013 has been moved or isolated in a protective Nen space. Hanzo only sees an empty copy from the outside. Vergei initially refuses this explanation, but Biscuit reveals his muscular form and convinces him of the existence of Nen.

The occupants discover that the space works in one direction: it is possible to go out and make a phone call, but anyone who leaves becomes incapable of finding, seeing or hearing the real room. At the banquet on the eighth day, several servants must go out to keep up appearances; Biscuit chooses to stay with Marayam.

On the tenth day, the cursed guard Taler is identified as tasked with targeting Marayam. The next day, the prince refuses Kacho's posthumous letter, then continues to play in the protected space with Sevanti, Biscuit and a servant.
abilitiesAndPowers: Due to his very young age and low rank, Marayam possesses no real political influence or known personal abilities. His behavior, fears, and traumas, however, determine the growth, appearance, and likely defensive power of his Guardian Beast.

equipment.name: Hamster cage
equipment.description: Cage containing three hamsters that Marayam transports to the festival stage and observes regularly.

equipment.name: Jouets
equipment.description: Miniature cars and bricks that Marayam plays with in his sheltered room.

guardianSpiritBeast.type: Unknown type · Likely Emission and/or Conjuration
guardianSpiritBeast.description: Quadruped dragon whose size and shape reflect Marayam's emotional state. At first slender, the creature becomes gigantic and bristling with thorns after Momoze's death, then adopts a more compact and aggressive form equipped with extendable toothed vines.
rules: Cannot fight another Guardian Spirit Beast
Cannot directly attack the host of another Guardian Beast
Only Nen users can see and hear it
Leaving the real room 1013 prevents you from returning
guardianSpiritBeast.ability: The Beast appears to have surrounded room 1013 with a space-time barrier. The people inside do not notice anything unusual and can go out or call. From the outside, any entry attempt leads to an empty copy; a person who has left the space can no longer see or hear its occupants, even with the door open. The ability appears defensive and could combine Emission and Materialization, but its exact functioning remains unknown.

description: True Fourteenth Princess of Kakin. Oito secretly exchanged his identity with that of his nephew; its location and situation remain unknown.

beyondLineage.evidence: Longhi asks Kurapika to investigate his hypothesis that Beyond fathered one of the fourteen princes.

identity.description: The protected infant in room 1014 is Oito's nephew and not the real princess. Woble's actual location is unknown.

biography: Woble is officially introduced as the Fourteenth Princess and Oito's daughter, supposedly participating in the succession contest under Kurapika's protection.
After Nen's second class session, Kurapika and Bill confront Oito about an infant swap. She recognizes that the child visible at her side is her nephew and not the real Woble.
The exact date of the exchange, the location of the real princess and her condition remain unknown. The actions observed in room 1014 therefore belong to the false Woble.
abilitiesAndPowers: No abilities, paranormal reactions, or Guardian Beasts can currently be attributed with certainty to the true Woble. The dark aura and danger reactions observed in Room 1014 relate to the substituted infant.

description: Infant nephew of Oito publicly introduced as the Fourteenth Princess Woble and protected in room 1014.

identity.description: Oito passes his nephew off as Woble. All scenes of the infant visible in room 1014 are now attributed to him.

biography: Woble is first seen in Oito's arms during the pre-departure festival, then asleep next to her during the onboard ceremony. Back in their quarters, a dark aura briefly emanates from his cradle and surprises Kurapika.

On the first day, Oito returns with the infant to room 1014 and discovers the bodies of four guards. Kurapika first suspects Woble or a possible Guardian Beast of having killed Woody upon perceiving his hostility. The baby cries just before Vincent arrives, while neither Kurapika nor Bill have yet sensed the danger.
When Vincent kills Sandra and tries to provoke the guards, Woble leans towards Kurapika. This gesture convinces Oito to trust him and makes their strategy against the assassin possible.

Oito takes Woble to meet Zhang Lei to exchange information about Nen. The Third Prince temporarily assigns Sakata and Hashito to his protection. Back in Room 1014, the infant mostly stays in his crib during Kurapika's operations and use of Little Eye.

When Emperor Time's abuse knocks Kurapika and Oito into unconsciousness, Shimanu watches over Woble for nine hours. Upon waking, the baby reaches out to Kurapika again, restoring Oito's confidence despite his doubts about his guard's priorities.

Woble sleeps next to Oito while learning Nen from Bill, then plays with a toy after Shimanu's innocence is verified. On the ninth day, the infant watches without waking up the forced initiation of new students in the master bedroom.

On the tenth day, Woble sleeps near Oito during Longhi's revelations about the cursed children of Beyond and his hypothesis regarding one of the princes. Oito instinctively places a hand in front of the baby while Kurapika accepts the investigation and the Moonlight Act pact.

The alliances negotiated by Kurapika stipulate that Woble and Tubeppa would relinquish the throne to Zhang Lei if they were the last three survivors. Tubeppa also agrees to have Woble accompany Kurapika to his room and states that she could even accommodate him.

After class, Kurapika and Bill confront Oito about an infant swap. She recognizes that the baby in room 1014 is not the real Woble but her nephew. The exact location and situation of the real princess remains unknown.

On the eleventh day, Oito is carrying the baby when she learns that any exit from the ship results in the death of the participants. Kurapika offers to make Kacho's letter public in order to protect Woble and the other young princes, then takes him to Room 1003 to analyze Zhang Lei's coins.
The infant sleeps during Nen's second class session on the twelfth day, while Kurapika, Bill and Shimanu organize the security of room 1014 against Camilla's guards.
abilitiesAndPowers: As an infant, Oito's nephew is entirely dependent on adults. Several reactions nevertheless suggest a paranormal sensitivity: he cries before Vincent's murderous arrival, seems to respond to Kurapika's requests for trust and could sense hostile intentions. A dark aura has also been observed around its cradle, but its origin remains unknown. Not being an eligible participant and not having received an egg during the Urn ceremony, no Guardian Beast or personal ability can be attributed to him with certainty.

equipment.name: Berceau et jouet
equipment.description: The infant spends most of the trip in his cradle or in Oito's arms and occasionally plays with a small toy.

description: Mother of Woble. Allies with Kurapika, learns Nen, uses 'Little Eye' (cockroaches) to spy.
biography: Oito hires Kurapika to protect her infant Woble, initially hoping to escape the ship. She learns that the voyage hides a battle to the death and chooses to remain beside her child despite the deaths and infiltrations in room 1014.

Kurapika awakens her aura nodes and lends her Sayird's Little Eye. Oito controls a cockroach through the ventilation system, spies on the neighboring rooms and witnesses Momoze's death, an experience that hardens her resolve.

She trains secretly under Bill while Kurapika's public classes draw rival camps into Woble's quarters. On the tenth day, linguistic clues expose that she exchanged the real Woble with her sister's baby; Kurapika decides to protect both children and conceal the substitution from the royal army.
abilitiesAndPowers: Oito has little combat experience but shows courage, political judgment and a rapidly developing awareness of aura. Her temporary use of Little Eye turns her into an effective reconnaissance operator.

nen.overview: Kurapika forcibly opened Oito's aura nodes. She can see and sense aura and briefly used Little Eye through Stealth Dolphin, though Bill considers her a slow learner.

description: Secret leader of the expedition. Self-detained in a VVIP prison on Tier 1, monitored by the Zodiacs.
biography: The Zodiacs learn of Beyond when Nasubi Hui Guo Rou introduces him as the leader of Kakin's expedition to the Dark Continent. Beyond claims that humanity originated there and invites all volunteers to follow him. His speech exceeds one hundred million views on EyeTube in one hour and the one hundred thousand telephone lines opened by Kakin are overwhelmed. Despite V5's order to cease, he asks the king to ignore it and proclaims his willingness to explore the unknown, respect those who wish to join or leave, and crush anyone who interferes.

Beyond then phones Beans and voluntarily surrenders himself to the Zodiacs, commissioned by the V5 to capture him. Detained at the Hunters' Association headquarters and interrogated by Cheadle, he predicts that V5 will eventually approve the expedition and that the Hunters will accompany him as overseers. Events prove him right: the Association becomes responsible for his guard while his objective remains to escape to the Dark Continent and join his own team.

When Saiyu is identified as Pariston's spy, Mizaistom offers Beyond to attend the ceremony preceding the departure in exchange for the identity of the mole. Beyond claims to know nothing and is only interested in what lies beyond the New Continent. Kurapika, who is observing the interview from a distance, concludes that he is telling the truth.

On August 7, Beyond participated in the ceremony alongside the princes of Kakin and greeted the crowd. He is then taken to a VVIP cell in Tier 1 of the Black Whale, where he reads quietly under the supervision of Saiyu, Saccho and Kanzai.
Beyond remains largely inactive until 2 p.m. on the tenth day of the journey. After finishing a book and joking with Kanzai, he asks him to help him arrange a meeting with a person.

The next day, Judge Cleapatro accepts his invitation. Despite his request, Kanzai and Saiyu refuse to leave them alone. Cleapatro and Beyond examine the 1,047 cases he filed against Kakin's government, all of which were rejected, then debate the definition of the people in the Constitution and the legal status of the royal family. Beyond studies the files, amendments and revisions made in his cell under the watchful eye of the Zodiacs, while revealing that he has known Cleapatro since his childhood.

On the twelfth day, Borksen remembers that Beyond's promise - or someone associated with it - to leave for the New Continent was the starting point for the threats now weighing on the ordinary future she desired.
abilitiesAndPowers: Beyond's accomplishments demonstrate exceptional power, intelligence, and planning ability. He manipulated the great world powers until forcing them to approve his project. He is one of the very rare explorers who have returned from the Dark Continent healthy in body and mind, which requires extreme survival and combat skills. His role as decision-maker on all matters related to the Dark Continent already made him the preeminent expert in the field fifty years ago.

nen.overview: His experience in the Dark Continent, the need to have him monitored by three Zodiacs simultaneously, and his authority over many Nen users make his mastery of Nen almost certain. He claims that he could smash Kanzai's skull with a book, although this threat seems to have been made in a joking tone.

description: Zodiac. Supervises the Tier 3 Central Police Station. Leads the large-scale criminal investigation.

nen.overview: His status as a former training partner of Isaac Netero testifies to Mizaistom's great mastery of Nen. Its ability is based on three colored cards comparable to penalty cards: the blue admits the target into the court, the yellow immobilizes him and the red expels him.
nen.combatProficiency: Mizaistom can use at least one of his cards on multiple targets simultaneously while hiding his aura with In.

biography: Mizaistom helps reorganize the Zodiacs for the Dark Continent expedition and leads security aboard the Black Whale. From Tier 3, he coordinates the police, courts and military response to disappearances and mafia violence.

He boards ahead of the crossing and turns straight to the three lower decks, where conditions are worse than the Zodiacs expected; with Botobai he helps the troops and the private security take hold of them. He phones Kurapika to say so and to excuse himself from the Zodiac meeting, then holds his first briefing with the Kakin royal troops in the Tier 4 conference room — the same room he will summon twenty chapters later to redeploy 800 soldiers to the lower tiers.

He intercepts Illumi and Kalluto, confirms that the Phantom Troupe is aboard and places them in monitored residential quarters. During special martial law, he continues the criminal investigation while trying to preserve the Justice Bureau's independence.

description: Zodiac. Sits as a judge at the Central Court (Tier 3). Towering, wrinkled and white-haired under an outsized judicial wig — taller seated than most men standing, which is what makes him unmistakable on the bench.
biography: Botobai joins the expedition's defense team and works as a senior judicial figure in Tier 3. He assists Mizaistom with the containment of Illumi and Kalluto and later participates in the Justice Department response during special martial law.

Triple-Star Terrorist Hunter and the eldest of the Zodiacs — Mizaistom reckons Beyond's plan was already fifty years old when even Botobai was a child, which is part of why no Zodiac can be cleared by age alone. The departure shows him on the bench of the Central Courthouse, the post he holds for the crossing; he leaves it only for the Tier 4 conference room when Mizaistom moves 800 soldiers to the lower tiers.

description: Zodiac. Held clandestine meetings with the science team in Tier 3 cabins.
biography: Gel serves on the Zodiacs' scientific team aboard the Black Whale. She takes part in expedition planning, medical coordination and discreet Tier 3 meetings as the voyage's security situation deteriorates.

nen.overview: Gel is a highly proficient Nen user and former sparring partner of Isaac Netero. She has shown a partial bodily transformation, while the rest of her abilities remain undisclosed.

description: Support Hunter affiliated with Kacho. Paralyzed the Tier 1 Banquet with his magic flute.
biography: Kurapika recruits Melody for the succession mission and she becomes Kacho's bodyguard. Her exceptional hearing lets her read heartbeats, recognize lies and coordinate secretly with Kacho and Fugetsu.

During the escape attempt, Melody performs for the Tier 1 banquet and broadcasts Nen-infused music that absorbs the attention of nearly everyone for three minutes. The diversion lets Kacho and Fugetsu reach an escape boat, although Kacho dies when they cross the succession boundary.

Melody is detained and questioned by the Justice Bureau. Kaiser asks her to perform again and helps design a plan to save Fugetsu, while Melody suspects that his unnaturally steady heartbeat may indicate Manipulation.
abilitiesAndPowers: Melody's supernatural hearing distinguishes individual heartbeats through walls, detects emotional changes and exposes falsehoods. She is also a skilled flautist whose supportive Nen can affect thousands when broadcast.

nen.overview: Melody projects aura through musical performance. Her songs calm emotions, relieve fatigue, produce vivid sensations and can monopolize the attention of a vast audience.
nen.combatProficiency: Her ability is non-lethal but exceptionally powerful for support, diversion and mass restraint.

description: Veteran Hunter, guard hired to protect the 13th Prince Marayam.
biography: At Killua's recommendation, Biscuit accepts Kurapika's mission and is hired to protect Prince Marayam. She quickly recognizes the parasitic Guardian Spirit Beasts and observes that Marayam's creature grows with his anxiety.

When room 1013 becomes isolated by a Nen barrier, Biscuit guards Hanzo's body during his astral projection. She later reveals her true muscular form to convince Vergei that Nen exists and begins organizing training for the room's occupants.
Biscuit identifies the barrier as Marayam's defensive ability after Belerainte can leave but not return. She remains inside the duplicated room with the prince and Queen Sevanti.
abilitiesAndPowers: A Double-Star Stone Hunter and veteran martial artist, Biscuit combines immense physical strength, decades of teaching experience and near-perfect aura control. Her youthful appearance conceals a much larger true body.

nen.overview: Biscuit is a master Transmuter with broad command of the other accessible categories. Her support ability summons Cookie, whose aura lotion and massages restore the body and compress rest time.
nen.combatProficiency: Her aura distribution, speed and raw strength are all at master level; her true form maximizes her striking power.

description: Hunter and ninja hired as guard for the 12th Prince Momoze then the 13th Prince Marayam. Uses astral projection.
biography: Hanzo is recruited by Kurapika and initially assigned to Momoze. Queen Sevanti transfers him to Marayam's room, leaving Momoze exposed; after her murder, he blames himself and vows to identify the killer.

Using Hanzo Skill 4, he leaves his sleeping body as an intangible double, finds the detained guard responsible for the murder and kills him. When the projection suddenly returns, he discovers that room 1013 has been spatially isolated.
Hanzo works with Biscuit to convince Vergei of Nen and prioritizes Marayam's protection while investigating the barrier created by the prince's Guardian Spirit Beast.
abilitiesAndPowers: A trained ninja and Hunter, Hanzo is an expert infiltrator, tracker and close-combat fighter. His discipline and knowledge of double-type abilities support covert investigation.

nen.overview: Hanzo is a Transmuter leaning toward Conjuration. His numbered fourth technique produces an astral double while his physical body remains asleep and vulnerable.
nen.combatProficiency: His projected double can pass through matter, fly, knock out guards and strangle a Nen user, but touch or speech directed at his body dispels it.

battles: Hanzo vs. Momoze's murderer

description: Tactician officer of 1st Prince Benjamin. Manages the application of Martial Law.
biography: Balsamilco commands Benjamin's private soldiers and advises the prince to avoid impulsive action until the Guardian Spirit Beasts are understood. He coordinates infiltrations of the other royal quarters and the legal use of self-defense.

He analyzes Halkenburg's collective aura and the risks of Manipulation, then develops a biological assassination using TSK-17. Disguised as a military physician, he approaches Halkenburg but is struck by the prince's arrow and exchanges bodies with him.
Halkenburg's consciousness uses Balsamilco's body to return toward Benjamin while the captain's own consciousness remains trapped in Halkenburg's dying body.
abilitiesAndPowers: Balsamilco is Benjamin's senior tactician, an experienced soldier and a scientific planner. He designs layered operations that exploit military law, biological agents and the succession rules.

equipment.name: TSK-17
equipment.description: A lethal biological agent prepared for the assassination of Halkenburg.

nen.overview: Balsamilco is a knowledgeable Nen user. His Ken blocks Camilla's bullets and he understands Manipulation priority, Guardian Spirit Beast restrictions and aura-output analysis.
nen.combatProficiency: His defense is strong enough to stop handgun fire at close range.

battles: Balsamilco Might vs. Halkenburg and his followers

description: Guard of Benjamin (murdered). Her 'Secret Window' skill continues to spy on Camilla.
biography: Benjamin assigns Musse to Camilla's quarters as a royal guard and spy. He marks Camilla with Secret Window, then shoots her when she advances on Benjamin's room.

Camilla's Cat's Name kills Musse and uses his life to resurrect her. Benjamin inherits Secret Window after his death, allowing the surveillance bird attached to Camilla to continue transmitting information.
abilitiesAndPowers: Musse is a trained royal soldier and intelligence specialist. His post-mortem-compatible surveillance ability is inherited by Benjamin after Camilla kills him.

nen.overview: Musse creates owl-like Nen beasts for remote surveillance. One listens through barriers; another attaches by touch and transmits a target's actions and speech.

battles: Musse vs. Camilla Hui Guo Rou

description: Benjamin's soldier using 'Predator'. Transferred to Salé-salé then Tubeppa.
biography: Rihan receives Benjamin's orders to infiltrate the other princes' guard details and is assigned to Salé-salé. He studies the prince's Guardian Spirit Beast without outside help so that Predator can evolve into its exact counter.

After gathering enough information, Rihan conjures a Predator that devours Salé-salé's beast and suppresses its influence. The successful activation leaves him unable to use Nen for forty-eight hours.

He is later transferred to Tubeppa. Rihan observes that her Guardian Spirit Beast appears immediately after the alliance with Kurapika, but must avoid being told too much if he wants Predator to remain effective.
abilitiesAndPowers: A trained soldier and highly analytical observer, Rihan specializes in deducing complex abilities from behavior. His power rewards independent, accurate analysis and punishes incomplete assumptions.

nen.overview: Rihan conjures a counter-creature whose form and strength depend on his personal understanding of a chosen enemy ability.
nen.combatProficiency: Predator can automatically neutralize a complex ability once fully adapted, but is poor against simple Enhancement or Emission and disables Rihan's Nen for 48 hours after success.

description: Tserriednich's personal guard, Hunter and Nen instructor. Marked by her Guardian Beast after attempting to kill the prince to prevent his power from growing.
biography: Before the trip, Theta, Salkov and three other Tserriednich guardsmen pass the 289th Hunter Exam. She informs the prince of the results, of the Association's lie checks and of the opposing guards who refused or failed. Tserriednich orders him to resume his defensive duties and study the plans of the Black Whale, including its exits, blind spots and reworked areas.

Two hours after departure, Theta and Salkov understand that Kurapika's announcement will push Tserriednich to learn Nen. Theta decides to teach him herself in order to slow down and control his progress. When she meets her guardian Spirit Beast, she is terrified but convinces herself that only she can still contain the prince.

Tserriednich, however, learned at a prodigious speed and mastered Gyo in half a day. When he discovers that a faster method of awakening exists, he accuses Theta of lying to him. She honestly explains that this method would be dangerous, but the Guardian Beast licks her cheek with a barbed tongue and leaves a wound.

After two days, Theta notices that the prince's theoretical reasoning already exceeds her own. She oversees his water divination, which reveals a Specialization of a particularly sinister nature. Understanding that she can no longer slow down her learning, she accelerates the exercises of Ten, Ren and especially Zetsu in order to create an opportunity to eliminate him.

On Sunday evening, Theta asks Tserriednich to hold Zetsu for an hour and tests his concentration with her own aura. When the Guardian Beast appears deprived of energy, it draws its weapon, regrets that its student does not use its genius for good and prepares to commit suicide after having shot it down.

Theta shoots and thinks she kills the prince just before being captivated by Melody's music. Three minutes later, the body and the blood disappeared; Tserriednich stands alive among his guards and claims the shooting was part of training. Her Beast warns Theta that a new lie will rob her of her humanity, then she faints.

Less than fifteen minutes later, Theta wakes up in her room with an infected lesion extending from her cheek. Salkov assumes that the creature keeps the liars alive to make them servants. Theta concludes that the prince's death was an illusion and seeks to determine when it began, without yet understanding Parallel Future.

Borksen then explains to his comrades that Theta and Salkov's change in attitude reveals how dangerous Nen is. During Theta's convalescence, Salkov returned to training and remembered his warnings about Tserriednich's necessarily selfish use of his talent.

On day eleven, Tserriednich activates Zetsu in 3.496 seconds while running, using his phone, and conversing. Salkov thinks of Theta and wonders how to contain such an absurd progression, while fearing that the testimony she gave about the Prince's Beasts has already been altered by Manipulation.
abilitiesAndPowers: A professional hunter, bodyguard and competent instructor, Theta has excellent theoretical knowledge of the four major principles and several advanced techniques. She quickly analyzes the risks linked to the Beasts of Nen, designs a program to control the awakening of a genie and maintains enough composure to act against a creature capable of detecting her lies.

equipment.name: Pistolet
equipment.description: Handgun used during Zetsu's exercise in an attempt to execute Tserriednich when his Guardian Beast could no longer protect him.

nen.overview: Theta sees the aura, uses Nen and knows how to teach it. Its natural affinity remains unknown. She has mastered Ren and Hatsu and can emit a weak aura projectile to test a student's concentration in Zetsu.
nen.combatProficiency: Her skill is above all educational and tactical: she knows how to explain the four great principles, introduce advanced exercises and modulate her aura to test a practitioner without hurting them.

battles: Theta vs. Tserriednich Hui Guo Rou

description: Deputy head of the Xi-Yu family. Operates on Lower Thirds.
biography: Hinrigh serves as Xi-Yu underboss and searches Tiers 4 and 3 for Hisoka while monitoring Morena's revolt. When three Heil-Ly members ambush him, he turns handcuffs into pigeons, traps Padaille and kills him.

He finds Hisoka in Tier 3, negotiates his transfer to a Tier 1 cinema and tries to keep him away from the Phantom Troupe. Hinrigh then cooperates with Nobunaga to probe the Heil-Ly teleportation trap.

Inside the hideout, Biohazard animals test doors, weapons and food. Hinrigh hides a transmitter in an oyster, swallows it and enters the trap so the Spiders can determine that the base lies between Tiers 2 and 3.
abilitiesAndPowers: Hinrigh is a composed mafia commander, knife fighter and investigator. He reads ambushes quickly and uses ordinary objects as flexible scouts, restraints and weapons.

nen.overview: Biohazard transforms touched objects into living animals while preserving the object's function. Hinrigh can direct the creatures until their aura is depleted.
nen.combatProficiency: His Ken and transformed objects withstand handgun fire; his En reaches at least five meters.

battles: Hinrigh Biganduffno vs. Padaille, Quorolle and Tevelares
Hinrigh Biganduffno and Nobunaga Hazama vs. the Heil-Ly Family

description: Operations Manager of the Cha-R family. Allies tactically with the Phantom Troupe.
biography: Ken'i Wang manages Cha-R operations on Tier 5. He confronts the Phantom Troupe after warehouse guards disappear, then concludes that a Heil-Ly attacker is trying to mark the Cha-R hideout for teleportation.

He and Tajao trade access and weapons for the Spiders' help against Luini and Morena. As the murders spread, Ken'i explains the mafia balance and formally asks the Troupe to eliminate the new Heil-Ly Family.
Although he serves Brocco Li, Ken'i privately intends to protect the Kakin state and contain damage to civilians, even if that requires manipulating both the mafia and the Phantom Troupe.
abilitiesAndPowers: Ken'i is an experienced underboss, negotiator and operational planner with authority over the Cha-R Family's Tier 5 personnel. No Nen ability has been revealed.

description: Revolutionary leader of the new Heil-Ly and Specialist. Contagion transforms up to twenty-two recruits into Nen users progressing through murder. Her introduction card gives her as level 45, born out of wedlock to a mistress of King Nasubi, and holding Prince Tserriednich by the throat.
biography: Morena embarks with at least twenty-two members of the Heil-Ly. She kisses each of them to activate Contagion, explains that killing earns levels, and releases her group onto the ship with the goal of destroying Kakin and then the entire world.

She took the head of the clan by ordering its members to kill one another, and the twenty-three she addresses in room 302 are the ones who chose to stay with her through it. She thanks them for that, calls herself young and inexperienced for the position, and says she cares nothing for this world any more than for herself — which is the reason she gives for destroying it.

Its recruits massacre passengers in order to reach level 21 and develop their own abilities. Their offensive causes hundreds of disappearances, upsets the balance of the three mafias and pushes the Xi-Yu as well as the Cha-R to consider its elimination.

Morena personally advises her members on their future powers. Facing Tevelares, Quorolle and Gelato, she explains that experience, technique, aura and ingenuity determine a Nen fight, then proposes transforming their clashes into systems comparable to games.

When her affair with Tserriednich falls silent, Morena understands that he suspects her betrayal. She abandons the decoy of room 3101, organizes several access doors to her real cache and wants to infect a soldier from Tserriednich in order to follow the movements of her former protector.

She distributes the roles between her subordinates: Yokotani and Orarge monitor the entrances, Notre and Soufflé observe the old lair, while Dogman must exceed level 50 and find a person meeting very specific criteria.

Hinrigh and Nobunaga cross the trap of room 3101 and discover a base with reinforced walls, probably by Morena's Nen. Hinrigh hides a transmitter there which allows the Brigade to conclude that the real cache is located in Tier 2.
Morena uses Halkenburg's funeral procession as cover for Dogman's operation, now level 62. He kidnaps Borksen, a soldier from Tserriednich and a wanted Specialist, then takes her to the secret base.

Morena suggests that Borksen join Heil-Ly as a “compatible donor” and imposes a negotiation game on her. The player questions Morena using seven thematic cards while the dealer gradually eliminates the five possible answers: Yes, No, Return, Joker and X.

The game forces Morena to reveal her goal, power, and sensitive information. She explains to Borksen her origins as "Flesh", her irrevocable desire to destroy Kakin and then the world, and the need for a Specialist capable of developing an ability still kept secret.

Borksen uses the Deal card to retrieve an answer in exchange for a kiss, one of the conditions of Contagion. The declaration of martial law briefly tenses Morena, but she continues the game and answers questions about her family and her hideout.

After several maneuvers, Borksen ends with Return then voluntarily chooses Yes. Morena tells him that she remains level zero until the last condition is fulfilled and that she will be able to return to her friends, but will be killed if she ceases to be useful. Cheating committed during the game also allows the manipulative component of Contagion to influence it.
abilitiesAndPowers: Morena commands the new Heil-Ly and all its members, who have become Nen users. She single-handedly staged a coup that transformed a trafficking organization into a network of revolutionary killers. Very intelligent, she views the progression of her recruits as a game, understands the categories, wishes and restrictions of Nen and guides them towards abilities compatible with their objectives. His faction officially controls Tier 3, while his real secret base is in Tier 2.

equipment.name: Negotiation game
equipment.description: Twelve cards used between a dealer and a player: seven questions for Morena and five final answers for the recruit. The result conditions the infection by Contagion and exposes both parties to risks serving as a restriction of Nen.

nen.overview: Morena spontaneously awakened Nen. Member Zero and level 45 of Contagion, she benefits from an increased quantity and flow of aura and could have developed a second ability. Nobunaga suspects that she is creating or strengthening the Heil-Ly's indestructible cache.
nen.combatProficiency: Its main danger lies in the organization, monitoring and collective growth of its recruits rather than in known direct combat.

description: Heil-Ly assassin and Emitter. His spatial portals connect a sealed room to places he has previously visited; Nobunaga kills him in Tier 5.
biography: Morena initiates Luini through Contagion. After surpassing level 21, he develops a spatial ability and uses portals to murder passengers and infiltrate mafia-controlled areas across the Black Whale.

Luini marks the Cha-R warehouse and tries to recruit the Phantom Troupe, imagining that they share his desire to destroy society. The Spiders reject his romanticized view of them and Nobunaga decapitates him when he exposes himself through a portal.
His death leaves the Heil-Ly teleportation network active through other members and pushes the Cha-R Family into an open alliance with the Troupe.
abilitiesAndPowers: Contagion increased Luini's aura and granted him a personal ability at level 21. He specialized in surprise attacks, reconnaissance and escape through armored sections of the ship.

nen.overview: Luini opens portals from a sealed room into a private transit space connected to locations he has visited. Opening the room's only door permanently resets that room as an anchor.
nen.combatProficiency: The ability is excellent for ambushes but requires a sealed single-door room and does not protect Luini while he exposes his body through a portal.

battles: Luini vs. Nobunaga Hazama

description: Leader of the Phantom Troupe and Nen prodigy. At Tier 3, he uses Love Dial 6700 to find the ideal ability before facing Hisoka again and plans to steal Kakin's regalia.

shipLocation.role: head of the Brigade / search for a capacity and regalia

biography: After having Kurapika's chain exorcised, Chrollo finally accepts the duel to the death demanded by Hisoka. Having become Floor Master of the Celestial Tower, he methodically prepares for combat by bringing together a set of complementary abilities and claims to have never needed so many powers to kill an opponent.

Chrollo opens the fight with Black Voice, then reveals The Sun and Moon and Double Face. His bookmark allows him to maintain an active ability while closing Bandit's Secret or combine two. He then introduces Order Stamp, Gallery Fake, and Convert Hands, explaining to Hisoka the rules of each power before announcing his certain victory.

He copies spectators with Gallery Fake, animates them with Order Stamp, hides in the crowd with Convert Hands and keeps certain copies with the post-mortem marks of The Sun and Moon. More than two hundred puppets end up surrounding Hisoka; their explosions kill him and destroy part of the arena.

After the fight, Chrollo restores Shalnark and Kortopi's abilities. He tells them that the Brigade will board the Black Whale to steal the treasures of the royal family of Kakin. Hisoka, however, is resurrected thanks to his post-mortem Nen and assassinates the two members before leaving.

On the Black Whale, Chrollo appears dejected by the deaths of Shalnark and Kortopi. He gathers the Brigade in the central mess hall of Tier 5, accepts Illumi among the Spiders and orders everyone to find and then kill Hisoka. He teams up with Shizuku and Bonolenov, giving them roles best suited to their abilities.

When Shizuku asks him to use Lovely Ghostwriter again, Chrollo finds that the ability has disappeared from his book, likely indicating Neon's death. The Brigade then heads to the upper levels while Chrollo coordinates his own strategy against Hisoka.

On the fourth day, Chrollo asks Bonolenov to take the appearance of Hisoka in order to deceive the mafias and facilitate the Brigade's access to the upper floors. The plan serves as a fallback while Chrollo searches for a specific ability that would allow him to kill Hisoka for good.

On the twelfth day, during Halkenburg's funeral procession, Chrollo circulates in Tier 3 and uses Love Dial 6700 to locate his "ideal partner". The device finding no one nearby, it concludes that the desired target is located in the upper levels.

Chrollo identifies Kakin's three regalia as national treasures that could satisfy the Skill Hunter upgrade requirement. He plans to reach Tier 1 to steal them, despite the risk of meeting Hisoka there before he is ready. In the crowd at the central hospital, Dogman perceives his aura and identifies him as a Specialization-type Floor Master.
abilitiesAndPowers: Chrollo is an elite fighter, an extremely methodical strategist, and one of the most talented Nen users in the series. He held his own against Silva and Zeno simultaneously, possesses exceptional speed and reflexes, masters unarmed combat as well as bladed weapons, and quickly analyzes the rules of an ability. His greatest strength remains his versatility: Skill Hunter allows him to construct complex combinations of stolen powers, prepared according to the opponent and the terrain.

equipment.name: Couteau de Ben
equipment.description: Ben-made knife whose poison is powerful enough to paralyze a whale with approximately 0.1 mg. Chrollo notably used it against Silva.

equipment.name: Antennes de Black Voice
equipment.description: Two antennas borrowed from Shalnark to manipulate Black Voice targets. They were lost or destroyed during the fight against Hisoka.

equipment.name: Black Voice Phone
equipment.description: Special bat-shaped phone owned by Shalnark. It was still in Chrollo's possession at the time of its owner's death.

nen.overview: A Specialization prodigy, Chrollo constantly maintains Ten, possesses a near-perfect Zetsu, and has enough aura reserve to combine multiple stolen Hatsu. His knowledge of restrictions, contractual loopholes, and post-mortem Nen allows him to exploit each ability beyond its obvious use.
nen.combatProficiency: He combines his abilities with remarkable tactical precision: against Hisoka, he prepared the ground, voluntarily explained his powers to influence his reasoning, created more than two hundred puppets and chained up to five stolen techniques around Skill Hunter and Double Face.

description: Member of the Phantom Troupe. On the front line against the Heil-Ly alongside the Cha-R.
biography: Nobunaga boards the Black Whale with the Phantom Troupe to rob Kakin and hunt Hisoka. On Tier 5 he, Phinks, Feitan and Franklin overpower Buor Family thugs and collect information about the mafia routes.

After the Troupe separates, Nobunaga investigates missing Cha-R guards with Phinks and Feitan. He identifies the attacker's marking strategy and agrees to hunt the Heil-Ly in exchange for access to higher tiers.

Luini appears through a portal and proposes an alliance; Nobunaga kills him instantly. He later enters Morena's hideout with Hinrigh, uses Shu and En to test its traps, and is forcibly expelled after they confirm the base's spatial structure.

Memories of Meteor City show the young Nobunaga joining Chrollo's dubbing group and the future founders of the Troupe. On the twelfth day, he separates from Phinks and Feitan in the recycling route to secure another path upward.
abilitiesAndPowers: Nobunaga is the Troupe's principal swordsman, an extremely fast iaijutsu practitioner with sharp tactical instincts in confined spaces. He can kill at the instant an opponent crosses his range.

nen.overview: Nobunaga is an Enhancer leaning toward Transmutation. His revealed Nen centers on reinforcing his swordsmanship rather than a named Hatsu.
nen.combatProficiency: His En extends four meters, matching the reach of his blade and defining a lethal response zone.

biography: The venue announcer presents Chrollo and Hisoka's death match at Heavens Arena, introducing the rules and addressing the audience before the fight turns the spectators into part of Chrollo's strategy.

description: Zodiac. Chief physician of the Tier 3 clinic.
biography: As chairwoman of the Hunter Association, Cheadle organizes the expedition's medical and scientific personnel and recruits Leorio. She supervises the Tier 3 clinic aboard the Black Whale.

On the eleventh day, her team receives the poisoned Halkenburg. Benjamin's royal medical unit removes the patient from her care, preventing the Hunters from determining the true cause of his collapse.

description: Zodiac. Flora and fauna team. Sits the departure logistics meeting in the Tier 3 first-class compartment.
biography: Cluck joins the expedition's flora and fauna team. Aboard the Black Whale, she remains with the Zodiac organization on Tier 3 and appears in operational overviews of the voyage.
The departure fixes that berth rather than assuming it: she is in the first-class compartment with Pyon, Gel, Ginta and three Hunters, working through the expedition's supply and transport logistics.

nen.overview: Cluck is a powerful Nen user and former sparring partner of Isaac Netero. She can manipulate hundreds of birds simultaneously and apparently possesses other unrevealed abilities.

description: Zodiac. Flora and fauna team. Sits the departure logistics meeting in the Tier 3 first-class compartment, and later supervises Illumi and Kalluto.
biography: Ginta joins the expedition's flora and fauna team and helps supervise Illumi and Kalluto after Mizaistom relocates them to Tier 3 residential units.
At the departure he is in the first-class compartment with Pyon, Gel, Cluck and three Hunters, which is what puts him on Tier 3 by observation rather than by assumption.

description: Zodiac. The archive holds her from the chapter 380 cutaway, which posts her in the Level 3 governmental and political zone at ten on the morning of the fourth day, with Mizaistom, Botobai, Cluck and Ginta; her earlier appearances in the arc have not been catalogued.
Zodiac. Stands the watch outside Beyond Netero's Tier 1 cell alongside Saccho and Saiyu.
biography: Kanzai serves on the expedition's defense team. He accompanies the Zodiacs aboard the Black Whale and remains active in Tier 3 security coordination through the voyage.

From the departure he is one of the three Zodiacs posted on the guard side of Beyond Netero's cell, with Saccho and Saiyu. Kanzai is the one who says out loud that three of them on a confined man is superfluous, which is what starts the talk of a rotation. Beyond jokes with him on the tenth day and asks him to arrange a meeting; when Judge Cleapatro comes on the eleventh, Kanzai and Saiyu refuse to leave the two of them alone.

description:
Zodiac. Physician affiliated with Cheadle.

**Succession Competition Arc**
Leorio is contacted by Cheadle who asks him to join the Zodiacs and accompany them on their journey to the Dark Continent. She explains to a confused Leorio that because of his actions during the election, he is highly regarded in the Hunters' Association. His presence would surely help the Zodiacs gain the influence necessary for the success of their mission. Leorio, ready to refuse, says that he must devote himself to his studies. Cheadle then informs her that he has been allowed to study abroad with her as his teacher. Realizing it's a unique offer, he agrees to be Ging's successor but then asks if there is room for another Zodiac, proposing Kurapika. As Kurapika is taken to the Hunters Association headquarters, he speaks to Leorio on the phone. Leorio asks him to give him his email address but Kurapika refuses. Kurapika says he heard about Gon's situation from Mizaistom and asks if there is anything he can do, but Leorio replies that their friend is fine and is more useful in the Zodiacs.

Leorio greets Kurapika upon his arrival at headquarters, stating that the mission seems more complicated than expected and wondering if they will make it through. Kurapika's only concern, however, is why they were given so little information. Cheadle then takes the lead and introduces them to the other Zodiacs. She begins to explain the V6, the Five Plagues, and the difficulty of the mission which is Rank A, while the Chimera Ants were Rank B. Leorio becomes worried, deducing that the mission he is embarking on is even more dangerous than the one in which Netero lost his life. Cheadle then asks if anyone has any questions. Kurapika raises his hand, saying he has a lot. The first is how many infiltrators on the Beyond Netero side the Zodiacs managed to identify, much to everyone's shock. When Kurapika and Mizaistom return to the room, Cheadle continues his speech. Leorio states that he will support his medical team in the Dark Continent and is happy to be allowed to join the expedition, promising to do his best. He is assigned to the Scientific Team.

When the Black Whale finally sets sail, Leorio is seen working at the medical center on Deck 3 under Cheadle's orders, carrying medicine and listening to his orders. Leorio is shown in the medical ward on Deck 3 with Cheadle and Gel.

On the eleventh day of the voyage, Leorio is part of a medical team led by Cheadle, tasked with caring for the 9th Prince Halkenburg, who (unbeknownst to them, at that point carrying Balsamilco's ego) is rushed to them at the hospital on Deck 3 after collapsing (also unbeknownst to them, as he was administered TSK-17). They were subsequently deported after the royal and military medical team sent by 1st Prince Benjamin came to care for Halkenburg and his condition.

**Relationships**
- **Cheadle Yorkshire**: Leorio's mentor and superior, she recruited him into the Zodiacs and supervises his medical studies and his integration into the scientific team.
- **Kurapika**: Close friend he recommended to join the Zodiacs.
- **Ging Freecss**: Leorio officially succeeds him as Zodiac.

**Nen**
Leorio is from the Show with a penchant for Reinforcement. Having postponed his training due to his college application, by the time he reunited with Gon and Killua in York Shin City, he could only use the Ten and was unaware of the existence of other techniques.
biography: Cheadle recruits Leorio into the Zodiacs and arranges for him to continue his medical studies as part of the expedition's scientific team. Leorio recommends Kurapika for the remaining Zodiac seat.
Aboard the Black Whale, he works under Cheadle in the Tier 3 medical center. On the eleventh day, he helps receive the collapsed Halkenburg before Benjamin's royal doctors take over the case.
abilitiesAndPowers: Leorio is a medical student, Zodiac and physically capable Hunter. His developing Nen complements diagnostic and surgical ambitions by carrying force through solid surfaces.

nen.overview: Leorio is an Emitter leaning toward Enhancement. He delayed advanced training for medical studies but later developed a remote strike.
nen.combatProficiency: Remote Punch travels along a surface and emerges at a chosen point, allowing force to bypass the space between Leorio and his target.

description: Zodiac. Intelligence team. Holds the Tier 3 first-class compartment, where she chairs the Association meeting shown at the departure.
biography: Pyon joins the expedition's intelligence team and contributes to the Zodiacs' information systems. She remains based with the Association contingent on Tier 3.

At the departure she sits a meeting of seven in the Tier 3 first-class compartment: the Zodiacs Gel, Cluck and Ginta, the doctors Sanbica Norton and Tokarine, and one more Hunter the chapter leaves unnamed. They work through the expedition's logistics — supply distribution, and the transport arrangements Tokarine's ability cannot carry alone. It is the room the Association contingent works from, and the only panel that fixes it.

She announces to the Zodiacs that she has been folding Ancient Language data into their software in case the expedition meets a Dark Continent civilisation, and that reconstruction comes first once the passenger list is retrieved. On the twelfth day Kurapika is still waiting on her sweep of the passengers under two years old for Prince Woble.

description: Zodiac. Stands the watch outside Beyond Netero's Tier 1 cell alongside Saiyu and Kanzai.
biography: Saccho joins the expedition's intelligence team and takes part in the Zodiacs' preparations, internal-security discussions and voyage coordination.

Saccho volunteers to watch over Beyond in prison as early as Cheadle's interview, and from the departure he stands the watch on the guard side of the cell with Saiyu and Kanzai. When Kanzai says out loud that three Zodiacs on one confined man is superfluous, Saccho privately agrees it is a waste of personnel and proposes they settle a rotation and put it to Mizaistom, so one of them can go help the royal troops.

description: Zodiac. Suspected of being Beyond's mole, and one of the three Zodiacs standing the watch outside his Tier 1 cell.

shipLocation.role: zodiaque / taupe potentiel, garde de Beyond

biography: Saiyu is assigned to the expedition's defense team but Kurapika identifies him as Beyond Netero's likely mole among the Zodiacs. The group chooses to monitor him rather than reveal the discovery.
His disclosed combat plan uses a conjured extending staff and three Nen monkeys that remove an opponent's sight, hearing and speech before he closes in.

From the departure he stands the watch outside Beyond's cell with Saccho and Kanzai — the suspected mole posted at the door of the man he is suspected of serving. When Judge Cleapatro visits on the eleventh day, Saiyu and Kanzai refuse Beyond's request to be left alone with her.
abilitiesAndPowers: Saiyu is a Blacklist Hunter and staff fighter. His disclosed strategy suppresses three senses before a finishing melee assault.

nen.overview: Saiyu conjures an extendable staff and employs three Nen monkeys. Successful attacks remove sight, hearing and speech and can destabilize the target's ability.

description: Hunter. Hired by Luzurus.
biography: Kurapika recruits Basho for the royal bodyguard operation and Luzurus hires him. He senses Halkenburg's overwhelming aura and investigates Shikaku's suicide outside room 1007.

Basho suspects a post-mortem curse and monitors Benjamin's guards while protecting Luzurus. He later coordinates with Melody and Kaiser during the attempt to identify the source of Fugetsu's condition.
abilitiesAndPowers: Basho is a Hunter, bodyguard and martial artist with strong intuition about curses, Nen puppets and post-mortem effects.

nen.overview: Basho writes haiku whose declared effect becomes real. The poem's quality and use of seasonal words strengthen the result.
nen.combatProficiency: His verses have produced flames, punished a liar and created a lasting protective light against weak spirits.

description: Hunter.
biography: Belerainte is a Pro Hunter serving in Marayam's guard detail. He joins Kurapika's classes as an experienced Nen user and quietly supports the strategy of buying time for as many princes as possible.
He tests room 1013's barrier by leaving it and discovers that he cannot return, confirming Biscuit's theory that Marayam's Guardian Spirit Beast has isolated the quarters.

nen.overview: As a Pro Hunter, Belerainte can use Nen. His natural category and personal ability have not been revealed.

description: Hunter and user of Reinforcement-type Nen. Guard of Queen Oito and Prince Woble, he is distinguished by support abilities rare among male Enhancers.
biography: Bill boards the Black Whale with Queen Oito, Woble and his colleagues. After the discovery of Woody's body, he accuses Kurapika of taking advantage of the Queen's trust. When other guards die and Kurapika interrogates them with his Dowsing Chain, Bill claims he was unaware of the War of Succession. He understands that the urn ceremony gave the princes parasitic Nen and shares his knowledge when several Guardian Spirit Beasts invade the room.

Although his true mission is the exploration of the Dark Continent, Bill promises to continue to protect Oito and Woble. After the manipulated Sayird kills Kurton and two immobilized guards, Bill holds him at gunpoint, but accepts Kurapika's decision to capture him alive. He then reveals that Kurton was essential to their escape thanks to his transformation into a vehicle, then explains Little Eye and the fallback solutions involving Beyond or Pariston.

The arrival of Vincent disrupts room 1014: Benjamin's soldier kills Sandra, then opens fire. Bill strengthens his guard with Nen, blocks the bullets and, with Kurapika's help, tackles Vincent to the ground. When he poisons himself, Bill tries in vain to make him spit out the poison. He finally agrees to hand over the body to Kakin's army after Kurapika shows him the earpiece worn by Vincent.

After calls from Benjamin, Zhang Lei and Tubeppa, Bill is given the task of monitoring Babimyna, Vincent's replacement. He stays with him while Kurapika accompanies Oito and Woble to Zhang Lei, then continues this surveillance after the arrival of Slakka, Hashito and Sakata.

Bill takes part in the search for an insect intended for Little Eye. When Oito spots a cockroach, Kurapika pretends to the guards that Bill is using a manipulation ability on the animal, while the Queen is actually controlling it. Bill plays along and then throws the cockroach into an air vent so Oito can spy on the next room.

After Oito's reaction to Momoze's death, Bill contacts his quarters and confirms that the princess died of asphyxiation without any entry having been observed. He worries that this affair will strengthen the other princes' desire to learn Nen, while recognizing that the courses could foster alliances. He organizes the arrival of their representatives and the Hunters, then watches over Kurapika and Oito for nine hours when they faint, hiding their condition from the other guards.

During Nen lessons, Bill secretly supervises Oito's training. After Barrigen is killed by Silent Majority, Kurapika tests him with the Dowsing Chain and clears him. Bill then accompanies him during Shimanu's interrogation, explains the difference between materialized snakes and snakes made of aura, then monitors the students when class resumes.

The next day, after Myuhan's death, Bill locks himself with Oito and Woble in the Queen's room. He reassures Oito by explaining that the murderer is targeting non-Nen users. Later, he accompanies Belerainte in front of room 1013 in order to cover the discreet transmission of his report.

When Halkenburg's rumbling aura manifests again, Bill helps Kurapika estimate its origin and becomes the second proctor of the water divination test. In the main chamber, he demonstrates Erigeron on a seed before Kurapika temporarily transfers his ability and part of his aura to the students to open their aura pores.

Bill fears that the powers handed out during classes will one day be turned against them. He admits to having chosen room 1014 because he believed it to be the safest, but explains that after the discovery of the War of Succession, he could not flee a position selected by cowardice. The exchanges between Kurapika and Oito finally made him decide to fully assume his mission.

On the tenth day, Bill and Kurapika receive Longhi for his initiation. She reveals that she has already mastered Nen, activates Moonlight Act and proposes a contract between the Woble and Tubeppa camps. Bill learns with amazement that she is a daughter of Beyond Netero, observes with Gyo the mark under his tongue and listens to his theory according to which Beyond fathered one of the fourteen princes of Kakin. He remains vigilant during the conclusion of the truce.

After Longhi's departure and Tenftory's divination, Bill understands thanks to the phonetic peculiarities of Kakin's language that Oito's pronunciation of Woble's name has changed. He then suspects an exchange of children. Tested with Kurapika's chain, Oito admits to having left the real Woble with his sister and that the baby in the room is his nephew.

On the eleventh and twelfth days of the trip, Bill agrees to protect Oito and Woble from the guards sent by Camilla during Nen's second class session. He stays in the main bedroom with Shimanu and watches as Kurapika demonstrates to Babimyna and Sakata the substitution of the child.

nen.overview: Bill is one of the few male Enhancers known to possess supportive abilities. He knows how to identify parasitic-type Nen, a phenomenon Kurapika had never heard of, and he is competent enough to supervise Queen Oito's training.
nen.waterDivination: Bill's water divination confirms his membership in the Strengthening.
nen.combatProficiency: His Ken is powerful enough to block at least four bullets fired at close range, although he was still slightly injured.

description: Hunter.

shipLocation.role: Hunter ; Royal Bodyguard for Prince Tyson

biography: Giuliano serves as one of Tyson's bodyguards. He reads the Book of Tyson, observes its emotional influence and remains in the prince's quarters while Izunavi evaluates the Guardian Spirit Beast's conditions.

description: Hunter. Master of Kurapika, hired by Tyson. Holds zone 6, where the chapter 362 sweep shows him at his post answering the princess about her Guardian Spirit Beast.
biography: Kurapika recruits his former Nen teacher as one of the trusted Hunters assigned to the princes. Izunavi becomes Tyson's personal bodyguard and studies the influence of her Guardian Spirit Beast and doctrine.

He warns Tyson that the succession cannot be escaped through idealism alone, monitors her guards and receives a copy of the Book of Tyson. He remains focused on protecting the prince without becoming emotionally manipulated by the book's effects.
abilitiesAndPowers: Izunavi is an experienced Hunter and Nen instructor who taught Kurapika the foundations of vows, limitations and Conjuration. His personal ability has not been revealed.

nen.overview: Izunavi is a proficient Nen user and teacher. He understands vows, restrictions, parasitic beasts and Manipulation, but his category and Hatsu remain unknown.

description: Hunter.
biography: Keeney is a Hunter guarding Kacho and Fugetsu. He pilots the escape craft during their attempt to leave the Black Whale and sacrifices himself after the succession ritual prevents their departure.
His plan gives the sisters a chance to flee, but Kacho is killed by the boundary and Fugetsu returns to the ship through her magical door.

description: Hunter selected to participate in the exploration of the Dark Continent. He was killed by Sayird while the latter was being manipulated by Prince Momoze's Guardian Spirit Beast.
abilitiesAndPowers: As a Hunter, Kurton enjoyed all the privileges associated with that status. His selection for exploration of the Dark Continent indicates that he was considered a powerful individual. However, he was easily killed by Sayird when he was controlled by Prince Momoze's Guardian Spirit Beast.

nen.overview: Kurton was a competent enough Materializer to have developed a Nen ability.

biography: Kurton boards the Black Whale as one of the Hunters assigned to Oito and Woble. His symbiotic vehicle transformation makes him essential to the expedition team's escape plan.
While controlled by Momoze's Guardian Spirit Beast, Sayird kills Kurton in room 1014. Bill later explains that his death removed their safest means of transporting the group.

description: Hunter attached to a royal guard detail. During special martial law, he overpowers and detains Kanjidol after the soldier arms part of Luzurus's guard detail.
biography: Ridge is a Hunter attached to a royal guard detail. He participates in the inter-prince information network and remains active during the later days of the succession contest.

description: Single-Star Virus Hunter and doctor. Sits the Association meeting Pyon holds in the Tier 3 first-class compartment at the departure.
biography: Sanbica joins the Hunter Association's medical personnel aboard the Black Whale and works with the scientific team on Tier 3.

At the departure she is one of the seven in the first-class compartment where Pyon meets Gel, Cluck, Ginta, Tokarine and one unnamed Hunter — the panel that first puts her somewhere on the ship rather than merely aboard it.

description: Hunter selected for the exploration of the Dark Continent and former guard of Prince Woble. He was controlled by Momoze's Guardian Spirit Beast, then overpowered by Kurapika and taken into custody.
abilitiesAndPowers: As a Hunter, Sayird enjoys all the privileges associated with this status. His selection for exploration of the Dark Continent indicates that he was considered a powerful individual. While he was controlled by Momoze's Guardian Spirit Beast, he was nevertheless easily subdued by Kurapika.

nen.overview: Sayird is an Emitter with a strong affinity for Manipulation. After using Kurapika's index finger chain, he was temporarily unable to use Nen and activate its ability for several hours.

biography: Sayird is selected for Beyond's Dark Continent team and assigned to Oito and Woble. Momoze's Guardian Spirit Beast takes control of him, causing him to murder Kurton and attack the other guards.
Kurapika subdues him and steals Little Eye with his index chain. The army takes Sayird into custody; after Oito uses the borrowed ability, it returns to him.

description: Hunter.

shipLocation.role: Hunter ; Royal Bodyguard for Prince Luzurus

biography: Scairt is a Hunter serving a royal faction aboard the Black Whale. He is among the professional guards whose presence and Nen knowledge become relevant to the princes' security arrangements.

description: Hunter Association medic. Debuts at the departure, in the Tier 3 first-class compartment meeting Pyon holds.
biography: Tokarine is a Hunter Association medical worker shown aboard the Black Whale at the beginning of the voyage.

Their one panel is the departure meeting in the Tier 3 first-class compartment, seated with the Zodiacs Pyon, Gel, Cluck and Ginta, Sanbica Norton and one unnamed Hunter. Tokarine is the Hunter meant to carry transport back from the Dark Continent to the staging base, and says so plainly: the ability cannot teleport and its capacity is low, nothing like Knov's, which is why Gel is told to find more transporters.

nen.overview: Tokarine is a Pro Hunter with a transport-oriented Nen ability. Its exact natural category is unknown, but the ability is classified as Emission.

description: Private, Temporary Hunter and Specialist wanted by Morena. Removed from the secret cache between Tiers 2 and 3, she is forced to accept Contagion at level 0.
biography: Borksen is a first-class soldier, provisional Hunter and former comrade of Tserriednich at the Military Academy. When Otocin reveals that she knows about the NEN, Gipper uses a transfer request as a test and eventually swaps her position with hers, sending her from the royal sector to Tier 3.

Meeting Momolly, Otocin and their friends on a reservation, Borksen confirms that Theta is secretly teaching Nen in Tserriednich. She does not yet know the details of this power, but Theta and Salkov's reactions are enough for her to compare it to a weapon classified as a defense secret. She recommends that the group avoid Morena and cooperate with Xi-Yu or Cha-R.

On the twelfth day, Borksen participates in the meeting with the mafias. She explains that the soldiers cannot directly approach the Heil-Ly, who knows their faces. During Halkenburg's funeral procession, Dogman abducts her without any memory of the operation.

Borksen wakes up unarmed in Morena's cache, surrounded by six people but without physical ties. Morena offers him to join the Heil-Ly as a "compatible donor" and warns him that the negotiation will gradually increase the risks for both sides.

Morena imposes a deck of twelve cards. Its seven cards make it possible to question its objective, its power, the consequences of Yes or No and to obtain a contract. Borksen's five answers are Yes, No, Back, Joker and X. Each round, Borksen eliminates one question and then Morena randomly removes one of her answers, until only one remains.

Borksen immediately analyzes the system's pitfalls. X cancels the negotiation; Return retrieves an answer from the graveyard; Joker becomes Yes or No. She also understands that the game is both an initiation, a compatibility investigation and a condition of Nen reinforced by the real possibility that Morena will fail.

With the Objective and Power cards, Morena reveals her desire to destroy Kakin and then humanity, recounts her origin as a Carnival orphan and describes Contagion. She explains that Borksen is a rare Specialist from whom she hopes to obtain an essential ability, although this has not yet been developed.

The Deal card allows Borksen to recover X in exchange for a kiss with Morena, one of the infection conditions. During the proclamation of martial law, Borksen uses the announcements and his questions to determine that the base is not on any bridge, but in a secret space between Tiers 2 and 3 with five entrances.

Borksen learns that the Heil-Ly has twenty-one members and that Morena is then their only Specialist. She asks several times if Morena will give up her goal and always receives the same negative answer, concluding that she cannot sincerely adhere to her project.

The last round leaves him with Back to No. Borksen keeps Return and appears to have won, but then chooses Yes in the graveyard. Morena reveals that she had discreetly marked the Back card: this cheating activated the manipulative component of the game, which now limits her decision to Yes or No and forces her to confirm her membership.

Morena welcomes him in the Heil-Ly. Kissing isn't enough though: Borksen remains level zero until she witnesses a murder committed by Morena or one of her allies. Contagion will then allow Morena to constantly know her level, position and condition until her death, that of Borksen or the attainment of level 100.

Borksen decides to return to his friends while assuming that Contagion can spy on his perceptions. Knowing that she risks being eliminated if another more useful Specialist is found, she finally asks Morena to introduce her to her new comrades before she leaves, already looking for a way to gain enough power to resist them.
abilitiesAndPowers: Temporary hunter and trained soldier, Borksen is above all remarkable for her intelligence, her composure and her reading of behaviour. Even when abducted, disarmed, and surrounded, she breaks down the odds of the game, spots omissions, uses martial law announcements to locate the cache, and obtains strategic information from Morena about her manpower, access, and Contagion.

nen.combatProficiency: No Hatsu or conscious use of Nen is yet known. Morena is, however, looking for a future capability in her that can fulfill a critical role for the Heil-Ly.

During Theta's recovery, Salkov takes over the lessons. He times Tserriednich's Zetsu and realizes that the prince is mastering in days what took him months, while investigating the possibility that Parallel Future activates during Zetsu.
abilitiesAndPowers: Salkov is a trained royal guard, provisional Hunter and Nen instructor. He understands Zetsu, aura beasts and the logic of Specialist abilities.

nen.overview: Salkov can see aura and has used Zetsu since birth, suggesting that his aura nodes were opened in infancy. No personal ability has been shown.

description: Queen of the Kakin Empire.
biography: Unma is Kakin's first queen and the mother of Benjamin and Tserriednich. She remains part of the royal household while both sons pursue competing strategies in the succession war.

description: Queen of the Kakin Empire.
biography: Duazul is Kakin's second queen and mother of Camilla, Tubeppa, Luzurus and Halkenburg. Her guards and children become entangled in several competing alliances and assassination plans.

canonicalName: Tang Zhao Li Hui Guo Rou
description: Queen of the Kakin Empire.
biography: Tang Zhao Li is Kakin's third queen and mother of Zhang Lei. Her relationship with the Xi-Yu-backed third prince places her household within the succession contest's mafia balance.

description: Queen of the Kakin Empire.
biography: Katrono is Kakin's fourth queen and mother of Tserriednich. She appears as part of the royal family records surrounding the fourteen princes.

description: Queen of the Kakin Empire.
biography: Swinko-swinko is Kakin's fifth queen and mother of Tubeppa and Tyson. She is introduced with the royal mothers as the succession contest begins.

description: Queen of the Kakin Empire.
biography: Seiko is Kakin's sixth queen and mother of Kacho and Fugetsu. She is outwardly severe with Fugetsu after Kacho's death while trying to maneuver within the royal hierarchy.
Her true intentions remain ambiguous as Melody and Kaiser work to protect Fugetsu from curses and political pressure.

description: Queen of the Kakin Empire.
biography: Sevanti is Kakin's seventh queen and mother of Momoze and Marayam. She transfers most guards from Momoze to Marayam, leaving her daughter dangerously exposed.
After Momoze's murder, Sevanti remains inside room 1013 with Marayam as his Guardian Spirit Beast isolates the quarters behind a spatial barrier.

description: Member of the Royal Army of Kakin.
biography: Gipper is a Kakin Royal Army soldier involved in the security operations that intensify during special martial law.

description: Member of the Royal Army of Kakin.
biography: Maizan is a Kakin Royal Army officer who appears during the search for Hisoka and is later referenced in the military response to the mafia conflict.

description: Member of the Royal Army of Kakin.
biography: Mizuri is a Kakin soldier who intercepts Illumi and Kalluto in Tier 3, checks their VVIP identification and attempts to escort them before the Zodiacs intervene.

description: Member of the Royal Army of Kakin.
biography: Momolly is a Kakin Royal Army member assigned to lower-tier security during the Heil-Ly investigation and the period preceding special martial law.

description: Soldier of Kakin, former comrade of Tserriednich and member of Borksen's group. He investigates the Heil-Ly and the disappearance of his friend in Tier 3.
biography: After the soldiers burst into the Heil-Ly offices in Tier 3, Otocin asks Corporal Gipper to prepare a strategy against possible Nen users. Gipper ignores this term; Otocin explains that this is a dangerous power spreading to Tier 1 and speculates that this threat explains Tserriednich's apparent inaction.

Otocin reveals he has the information from Borksen, temporary Hunter assigned to the royal quarters. Gipper decides to request his transfer as advisor, then threatens to gouge out Otocin's eyes if he shortens the prince's name again. Otocin, however, continues to use the nicknames “Tserried” and “Tserri”, much to the annoyance of his superior.

With Momolly and their friends, Otocin analyzes Tserriednich's behavior and Morena's rebellion. He believes that she would not have challenged the prince without a plan, and that their former comrade must ask himself if he really wants to pursue this path. Despite his provocative humor, Otocin prefers to remain a simple soldier to maintain the freedom to speak frankly to Tserriednich.

When Borksen joins the group, she confirms that Theta is secretly teaching Nen to the prince and compares this power to a classified weapon. She blames Otocin for having caused her transfer; he argues that the soldiers needed this information and that their early warning system could thus be established.

Otocin then participates in the meeting with representatives of the Xi-Yu and Cha-R families. The group seeks to capture Morena without attracting the attention of the royal army or the police, while cooperating with the mafias to search Tier 3.

On the twelfth day, after the funeral procession from Halkenburg passed near the general hospital, Otocin found Momolly and their friends. They discovered that Borksen had not given any sign of life for about thirty minutes. Otocin fears that the Heil-Ly has kidnapped her and manipulated her by Nen in order to use her against Tserriednich, but a corporal disperses the group before they can act.
abilitiesAndPowers: A trained soldier, Otocin stands out above all for his quick wit, his provocative humor and his quick understanding of political issues. Although he has not mastered Nen, he early on identifies this threat as more dangerous than a gun, obtains Borksen's early transfer, and correctly envisions that the Heil-Ly could use Manipulation.

equipment.name: Pistolet
equipment.description: Handgun authorized by Gipper for discreet search of Tier 3, so as not to attract the attention of the royal army and the police.

description: Member of the Office of Justice.
biography: Cleapatro works for Kakin's Office of Justice. He appears during the voyage's legal proceedings and remains involved after the declaration of special martial law.

description: Member of the Office of Justice.
biography: Kaiser is a senior official of Kakin's Justice Bureau. He questions Melody after the banquet performance and offers legal assistance for Kacho and Fugetsu's escape plan.

After Kacho's death, he protects Fugetsu through judicial procedure and works with Melody to stage another concert. His perfectly constant heartbeat makes Melody suspect that he is manipulated or acting under an unusual mental condition.
During special martial law, Kaiser uses the Justice Department's independence to shelter Fugetsu and coordinate the next phase of the plan without surrendering her to Benjamin's forces.
abilitiesAndPowers: Kaiser combines legal authority, knowledge of the ship's security procedures and careful political negotiation. No Nen ability has been confirmed.

description: IPA member on loan to Kakin's Justice Bureau. Shares Steiner's Tier 1 quarters, where he debuts at the departure.
biography: Peuckert is a Justice Bureau employee aboard the Black Whale who supports the department's administration and later legal operations involving the princes.

He is in fact one of the IPA members lent to the Bureau's Investigation Department alongside Steiner, and he debuts in their Tier 1 quarters at the departure: when Steiner says one of them will succeed him as Deputy Secretary if he dies, Peuckert is the one who answers that the Hunter Association is there to protect them and that the current IPA Director is one of the unofficial sole survivors. The chapter does not name him — that waits twenty-five chapters, until 384.

description: Deputy Secretary of the International Permit Agency, on loan to Kakin's Justice Bureau for the voyage and assigned as Beyond Netero's guide. Tall, bespectacled; reads Journey to the New World in his Tier 1 quarters.

shipLocation.role: IPA Deputy Secretary ; guide de Beyond

biography: Steiner represents the International Permit Agency and accompanies the voyage. He observes Kakin's expedition from its announcement through the Black Whale's developing crises.

As Deputy Secretary he coordinates every Restricted Voyage Agency, and once the V6 clears Kakin's expedition he is made Beyond Netero's guide. He and several other IPA members are lent to Kakin's Justice Bureau Investigation Department for the duration of the crossing, which is why the archive files him with the Bureau rather than with an agency of his own.

At the departure he is in his Tier 1 quarters with three other IPA members, reading Journey to the New World and telling them to at least get through the chapter on the labyrinthine city — if he dies, one of them becomes Deputy Secretary. Peuckert answers that the Hunter Association is there to protect them and that the current IPA Director is one of the unofficial sole survivors. The chapter gives the tier and the room's function, never its number: the VVIP quarters are where Tier 1 lodges dignitaries, so the position stays an inference.

biography: Worio Bay is an Office of Justice official introduced during the legal and medical response to Halkenburg's collapse.
