biography: Mandam is a Black Whale passenger pictured during the opening days of the succession contest.

description: Servant of Queen Oito and Prince Woble. She was murdered by Vincent in room 1014.
biography: Sandra and Shimanu are the only two servants who chose to stay with Queen Oito after Sayird was taken into custody by Kakin's army.

Later, bodyguard Vincent rings the doorbell of Prince Woble's room. Sandra opens the door and Vincent kills her as soon as she enters. He claims that she tried to attack him with a knife and that she was carrying a small vial of poison, presenting her action as self-defense. As Sandra collapses and dies, Vincent draws a gun to defend himself against Kurapika.

description: Servant of Queen Oito and Prince Woble. The only remaining servant after Sandra's death, she is an insightful political advisor and a reliable ally of Kurapika.
biography: After the mysterious deaths of four bodyguards, Shimanu is one of the four handmaidens questioned by Kurapika. She claims to know nothing about the War of Succession, then listens as the two traitorous royal guards explain the conflict and the methods of surveillance targeting the princes born to the second through eighth queens.

After the controlled Sayird kills the other guards and attempts to attack Kurapika, Kakin's army takes him in for questioning. Two servants then leave their post: only Shimanu and Sandra choose to remain in the service of Queen Oito and Prince Woble.

When Vincent kills Sandra, Shimanu becomes the Queen's sole servant. She witnesses the fight between Vincent and Kurapika and Bill, then responds to the calls of Princes Benjamin, Zhang Lei and Tubeppa. Despite Kurapika's order to respond to the First Prince, she prioritizes Zhang Lei. She considers Benjamin too ruthless to negotiate, Zhang Lei potentially generous but sensitive to disrespect, and Tubeppa likely to offer amnesty to lesser princes while using their influence against the higher ranked ones. His advice on Babimyna convinces Kurapika to trust him.

Shimanu then helps Oito and his guards find a cockroach for Little Eye. Oito entrusts Woble to her while she uses the animal to spy on Prince Marayam's room. Shimanu remains with the child even after Oito's violent reaction to the news of Prince Momoze's death.

When Kurapika and Oito lose consciousness, Shimanu watches over the Queen during the nine hours of her unconsciousness. When he wakes up, she tells him that Woble is resting in his cradle. She worries about the plan to monitor Tserriednich, but confirms Kurapika's arguments. She then notices with a smile that Woble stands up and extends his arms towards him. Shimanu remains at Oito's side during another surveillance attempt, interrupted when the Fourth Prince's guardian Spirit Beast devours the manipulated creature.

While setting the table, Shimanu is targeted by Kurapika, who suspects her of being the Silent Majority user. She maintains her innocence and explains that she only discovered Nen the day before. Kurapika apologizes to him. She then stays with Oito and Woble in an adjoining room while Nen's lessons resume. Asked why she remains despite the danger, she mentions her loyal family in Kakin and exchanges with Oito about their respective families.

At the end of the lesson, Shimanu returns to room 1014. During the night, she answers the phone and informs Kurapika that the captain of Prince Marayam's guards wishes to speak with him, then serves dinner.

On the eleventh and twelfth days of the trip, Shimanu is instructed to stay with Oito and Woble during preparations and the start of the second session of Nen classes. She stays with Bill in the master bedroom of room 1014 to watch over the Queen and Princess.
abilitiesAndPowers: Shimanu has remarkable knowledge of the reasonings of several princes and their guards. She knows how to use this information to assess their intentions, prioritize risks and recommend sensible policy decisions.

description: Bodyguard assigned to Queen Oito and Prince Woble, but identified after her death as a spy sent by a higher-ranking queen.
biography: Woody is assigned to protect Queen Oito and Prince Woble during the trip. He dies between 12:15 and 12:30 on the first day — the ship leaves port at noon, so within the half hour that follows it — and his dried body is discovered on the bathroom floor of room 1014. His death was attributed to exsanguination.

Kurapika reaches the bathroom shortly afterwards, with Bill, Kurton, Sayird and two more of the detail. His is not the only body of that afternoon: coming back from the inaugural banquet, the same group finds four more bodyguards drained of blood in a corridor of the royal residential sector. Five deaths in one afternoon is what turns an unexplained corpse into the pattern Kurapika reads as parasitic Nen.

The interrogation of the following chapter puts his death in its set: the five guards killed that afternoon were each serving a queen other than Oito, the seven higher-ranked ones having posted informants around the lowest-ranked of them. After learning that Woody was a spy sent by one of the higher-ranking queens, Kurapika speculates that he may have been killed by Woble's Guardian Spirit Beast when the princess felt threatened. Silent Majority's subsequent attacks, however, seem to refute this hypothesis. Woody reappears in a memory of Woble during a conversation between Kurapika, Bill and Oito, on the afternoon of the twelfth day of the journey, before special martial law was declared.

description: Head of the Xi-Yu mafia family and half-brother of King Nasubi. Godfather of Zhang Lei, he runs the Tier 1 VVIP districts from there.

shipLocation.role: boss of Xi-Yu / advisor to Zhang Lei

biography: Onior boards the Black Whale and takes up residence in the Tier 1 VVIP residential area. As the leader of the Xi-Yu and godfather of Zhang Lei, he maintains a direct link between the ship's mafia and the royal succession.

On the fourth day, Brocco Li informs him that the Phantom Troupe are on board. The two half-brothers discuss the balance between families and decide to let the Heil-Ly and the Spiders weaken each other, while controlling when the confrontation occurs. Onior then orders Hinrigh to find Hisoka before the Brigade does.

On the seventh day, Onior receives Zhang Lei, who has come to ask his advice on Nen and the Guardian Beasts. He claims to know nothing about these notions, despite the existence of special powers among certain subordinates, and recommends that the prince imitate Nasubi's patience during his own succession.

After Zhang Lei's departure, Hinrigh reported to him about the massacres committed by the Heil-Ly and the Brigade's unexpected cooperation in the search for Morena. Reassured about the absence of Hisoka in Tier 4, Onior authorizes the Spiders to search the floor and instructs Hinrigh to pursue Morena to Tier 3 and then kill her.

On the twelfth day, just before martial law is declared, Zhang Lei crosses an interior gateway from Onior's residence into Tier 2. Benjamin assumes that he is seeking refuge at the Ministry of Justice or trying to join his mafia allies in the lower levels.
abilitiesAndPowers: Leader of the Xi-Yu, Onior commands one of the three most powerful criminal organizations in Kakin. His family has the largest financial resources and staff of the three mafias, controls Tier 4 and makes its profits from human trafficking and the distribution of goods. Supported by Zhang Lei, Onior has direct authority over Hinrigh and communication channels with Brocco Li's Cha-R. No personal abilities of Nen are confirmed.

description: Head of the Cha-R mafia family and half-brother of King Nasubi. Godfather of Luzurus, he resides in the VVIP Tier 1 districts.

shipLocation.role: boss of Cha-R / godfather of Luzurus

biography: Brocco boards the Black Whale and settles in the VVIP zone of Tier 1. From this residence, he rules the Cha-R, supported by the Seventh Prince Luzurus and mistress of Tier 5 as well as the goods stored there.

On the fourth day, his deputy Ken'i Wang tells him that the Phantom Troupe is in Tier 5. Brocco telephones his half-brother Onior and describes the Spiders as a force difficult to control, lacking the etiquette expected of the powerful and admired even by some of his own men.

Brocco and Onior decide to let the new Heil-Ly and the Brigade destroy each other, while ensuring they control the moment of their confrontation. Brocco then summons Ken'i and orders him to find Hisoka before the Spiders.
On the seventh day around 10:30 p.m., Brocco took advantage of his large collection of exotic animals in his residence.
On the twelfth day, Ken'i explains to Nobunaga, Phinks and Feitan that Cha-R executives, including Brocco, attended the official transfer ceremony that placed Morena at the head of Heil-Ly.
abilitiesAndPowers: As leader of the Cha-R, Brocco commands one of Kakin's three major criminal powers and numerous subordinates, including Ken'i Wang. Supported by Luzurus, his family controls Tier 5 of the Black Whale and all goods that pass through or are stored there. Brocco coordinates his strategy with Onior's Xi-Yu in order to preserve the mafia balance. No personal abilities of Nen are known.

equipment.name: Collection d'animaux exotiques
equipment.description: Vast private menagerie kept in his VVIP residence and with which Brocco spends his free time.

description: Passager / Autre affiliation.
biography: Morrissey is a Black Whale passenger mentioned during the first round of Kurapika's Nen classes.

description: Tier 3 civilian passenger mistaken for Hisoka by Lynch during the Xi-Yu family's search.
biography: While walking with friends to Tier 3 of the Black Whale, Hanal is spotted by Zakuro and Lynch, who are looking for Hisoka for the Xi-Yu family. Lynch asks him if he is Hisoka and then immediately punches him in the stomach when he tries to explain to her that she is wrong. His Nen ability causes a voice to emerge from his body confirming that he is telling the truth. As Hanal collapses, his friends threaten to call the authorities; Lynch orders them not to interfere in the matter and invites them to take their complaints to the Xi-Yu headquarters of Tier 4.

description: Nen assassin whose identity remains unknown. He infiltrates Kurapika's classes and eliminates his victims with a curse of materialized snakes.
biography: After the discovery of Woody's bloodless body in the bathroom of room 1014, four other guards are found dead in the same manner upon returning from the first Sunday banquet. Kurapika suspects a Nen attack from an assassin hiding in the area, but the identity of the user remains unknown.

On the second day, during Kurapika's first Nen class, the assassin activates They Were Eleven: Silent Majority. A masked puppet appears behind Furykov, but only the user and Loberry, the possessed person, can see it. The assassin observes the security around Oito and Woble and chooses a victim from the ten people within range.

When Myuhan crosses the white line and distracts the group, the user considers striking but finds that he is outside the ten target zone. As premature deactivation without a victim would turn the curse against him, the assassin accepts the risk and waits for a new diversion.

Loberry eventually notices the puppet and draws all eyes to it. The user then launches four snakes against Barrigen. The creatures pierce his body with multiple mouths and completely drain his blood in eleven seconds. Sakata shoots the snakes, visible even to people without Nen skills, before they disappear.

Kurapika concludes that the snakes are materialized and probably visually controlled by Manipulation. Bill points out that their visibility increases the risk of discovery and therefore strengthens capacity. The next day, Myuhan is found dried out in a bathroom; the attack lasted less than ten seconds and the last creature disappears when the user deactivates their Nen.

The assassin does not strike again during the following days, but remains an unresolved threat. On the eighth day, Kurapika notices his silence while facing a new aura wave. On the twelfth day, Naipei is still worried about the murders from the first class and Belerainte asks him to report any appearance of a masked girl.
abilitiesAndPowers: The user is sufficiently proficient in Nen to develop a curse likely combining Materialization and Manipulation. He understands how dangerous conditions, limited range, creature visibility, and the risk of returning curses increase a Hatsu's power. His ability to observe and comment on the lesson without being identified suggests great mastery of concealment and planning.

nen.overview: The exact affinity is not officially confirmed, but Silent Majority materializes snakes visible to all and appears to direct them from a distance by sight. The ability relies on strong restrictions and a curse that can backfire on its user.
nen.combatProficiency: Four coordinated snakes can drain a person of all blood in eleven seconds. The user favors targets without Nen, enclosed places and diversions which prevent assistance from reacting in time.

description: Member of the Phantom Troupe and Gyudondond warrior. In Tier 1, he transforms into Hisoka then into Owl to carry out Chrollo's plan.

shipLocation.role: scout transformed into Owl / search for Hisoka

biography: Bonolenov boards the Black Whale with the Phantom Troupe and begins the search for Hisoka in Tier 5. On the fourth day, the Spiders gather in the central mess hall. After the group leaves, Bonolenov and Shizuku ask to team up with Chrollo, while accepting that their leader claims the right to kill Hisoka.

Shizuku believes that their abilities are poorly suited to Bungee Gum. Bonolenov clarifies that he can transform rather than simply disguise himself thanks to Battle Cantabile: Metamorphosen, but admits to lacking strategic sense. Chrollo then entrusts him with a precise plan. The trio then reaches Tier 4 through the central passage.

On Chrollo's instructions, Bonolenov takes the appearance of Hisoka and shows up in areas monitored by mafias. The plan is to push them to hide him in the upper quarters to preserve their balance, then to let the Brigade freely search the lower floors, believing Hisoka to already be isolated.

In Tier 3, Lynch hits the fake Hisoka and discovers through Body and Soul that he is an imposter. Bonolenov knocks her out with a blow to the liver so quickly that Zakuro doesn't see it, then neutralizes Zakuro, takes her appearance to verify what Lynch understood, then kills the latter. He finally transforms into Lynch in order to trick Zakuro and lead the mafia to the cinema.

On the twelfth day, still transformed into Hisoka, Bonolenov fortuitously encounters the real Hisoka in the Tier 1 casino. Remembering Chrollo's warning, he immediately adopts the appearance of Owl and continues to circulate in the casino, worried that the mafia will discover Lynch's murder and trace it back to him.

In his new form, Bonolenov reflects on Chrollo's pain after the deaths of Shalnark and Kortopi. He understands that the leader is looking for an ability and treats them necessary to improve Skill Hunter in order to permanently kill Hisoka. Bonolenov nevertheless hopes that the other Spiders will reach Hisoka before Chrollo and that this last fight will conclude their performance.
abilitiesAndPowers: A member of the Phantom Troupe with a Class A bounty, Bonolenov is a professional assassin, agile fighter and accomplished dancer. The ritual holes in his body transform his movements into music and his music into combat power. He possesses great speed, enough strength to knock Lynch out with a single blow, and an aura so menacing that it makes Zakuro tremble. Although he calls himself a bad strategist, he quickly analyzes Body and Soul and improvises a complex chain of impersonations.

nen.overview: Bonolenov materializes weapons, destructive masses or transformations using Battle Cantabile. His Hatsu are linked to his Gyudondond heritage: he dances and circulates air through the holes in his body to produce the necessary melodies. The duration or power seems to depend on the song, the dance and the number of holes exposed.
nen.combatProficiency: He fights by dancing, avoids attacks with grace and can perform convincing transformations. Metamorphosen allows him to imitate Hisoka, Zakuro, Lynch and then Owl, while Prologue and Jupiter give him a melee weapon and a massive pursuit attack respectively.

description: Member of the Phantom and Materializing Brigade. She accompanies Chrollo and Bonolenov in the search for Hisoka and is located at the central passage connecting Tiers 4 and 5.
biography: After the decision to steal Kakin's treasures, Shizuku boards the Black Whale with the Phantom Troupe. During the first days, the Spiders search Tier 5 in search of Hisoka, who has just murdered Shalnark and Kortopi.

On the fourth day, the Brigade meets in the crowded central mess hall of Tier 5. When the Cha-R family demands their table, the Spiders leave without conflict. Chrollo allows everyone to search for Hisoka as they wish and orders the group to return with his head.

Shizuku and Bonolenov immediately join Chrollo and ask him to team up. She recognizes that Blinky and Bonolenov's abilities are ill-suited to Bungee Gum, but plans to search for Hisoka in disguise. Chrollo agrees on the condition that he delivers the fatal blow himself.

Shizuku then asks Chrollo to use Lovely Ghostwriter again to read their fortunes and get clues. He reveals to her that the ability has disappeared from Skill Hunter, presumably involving Neon Nostrade's death. After a silence, Shizuku again compares Chrollo's book to the Death Note, which Bonolenov gently reproaches her for.
Later that day, Shizuku, Chrollo and Bonolenov are located at the central passage of Tier 4 connecting Tiers 4 and 5, continuing their progress towards the upper levels.
abilitiesAndPowers: A member of the Phantom Troupe and a Class A criminal, Shizuku is an experienced fighter whose rare ability is key to erasing the evidence left behind by the group. She wields Blinky like a club, can suck blood from an open wound, and has high Enhancement skills for a Materializer, having survived a car explosion unscathed.

nen.overview: Shizuku materializes Blinky, a vacuum cleaner with virtually unlimited absorption capacity. She masters Ten, Hatsu and Gyo, which she applies in particular to her eyes to protect against In.
nen.combatProficiency: Blinky serves as both a tool, a blunt weapon, and a means of exsanguination. The restriction that prevents her from sucking up living beings and Nen objects also allows Shizuku to spot certain traps.

description: Member of the Phantom Troupe and Elite Transmitter. He waits for Hisoka to come to him in the central dining hall of Tier 5.
biography: On the second day of the journey, Franklin is traveling through Tier 5 with Phinks, Feitan, and Nobunaga when they encounter three members of the Buor family. They try to intimidate them without recognizing the Brigade, but are easily beaten and taken to the central refectory for questioning.

The Spiders force their prisoners to explain the organization of Kakin's three mafia families. Franklin offers to provoke all three and asks which one is the most powerful. Learning that the Xi-Yu dominates by its financial means and its personnel, he demands that Buor's men summon the collector of their tribute. Phinks then orders them to raise the cabins of all passengers taller than 1.88 meters in order to find Hisoka.

On the fourth day, the Brigade assembles in the crowded central mess hall. Franklin sits on the opposite end from Chrollo. When the Cha-R demands their table, the Spiders retreat without a fight, then Chrollo disperses the group with orders to bring back Hisoka's head.

Franklin chooses to stay alone in the refectory and is eating there when Ittoku, consigliere of the Cha-R, comes to question him. He explains that he is not wasting his efforts: since Hisoka wants to kill the Spiders, he will eventually come to him. He denies the Brigade's involvement in the warehouse attack and states that they will not move on to stealing the treasures until they have eliminated Hisoka.

At ten o'clock the same day, an overview of the Black Whale confirms that Franklin is still alone in the central mess hall of Tier 5. The other members later contact him during their hunt for the Heil-Ly Killer.

On the tenth day, when Nobunaga is considering re-forming pairs, Phinks believes that Franklin would refuse to wait in the cramped Cha-R base, because he hates confined spaces. They instead consider letting him search outside while Phinks and Feitan guard the base, but Franklin remains their waiting point above all against Hisoka.
abilitiesAndPowers: A Class A criminal and experienced member of the Phantom Troupe, Franklin combines an immense reserve of aura, great physical resistance and firepower capable of taking down dozens of opponents in a matter of seconds. Calm, pragmatic and unimpressible, he often serves as the reasonable voice of the group. Its projectiles pass through Nen puppets and retain enough force to kill those shielded behind them.

nen.overview: Franklin is an Emitter with a dual affinity to Reinforcement. He can project hundreds of aura bullets without visible fatigue and his stamina allowed him to escape a car explosion unscathed.
nen.combatProficiency: Double Machine Gun's cadence, speed, and power allow it to saturate a large area. The intentional mutilation of his fingers acts as a restriction and significantly strengthens each projectile.

battles: Franklin Bordeau, Phinks Magcub, Nobunaga Hazama and Feitan Portor vs. men of the Buor family

description: Member of the Ghost Brigade and Enhancer. With Feitan, it progresses to the higher tiers through the recycling facilities located between Tiers 4 and 5.
biography: On the second day of the trip, Phinks, Feitan, Franklin and Nobunaga subdue three men from the Buor family at Tier 5. During the interrogation, Phinks understands that a middleman collects the profits between the leaders and their men. He then orders the prisoners to take down the cabin numbers of all passengers taller than 1.88 meters in order to find Hisoka.

On the fourth day, the Brigade meets in the central dining hall then disperses on Chrollo's orders. Phinks and Feitan accompany Nobunaga to the depot to retrieve their clandestine weapons, refusing to give Hisoka even the slightest chance to catch any of them isolated.

In the warehouse, a Cha-R guide suddenly disappears before being found with his throat cut. Phinks analyzes the scene, follows a trail of blood and rules out Hisoka's involvement. When Ken'i confronts them, he deduces that the killer is seeking to mark the lair in order to later unlock a teleportation capability there.

The three Spiders agree to kill Luini in exchange for access to the higher levels. On the seventh day, Phinks asks Ken'i and Tajao to locate Morena and promises them that the Brigade will come together to hunt down the Heil-Ly Killer.

On the tenth day, Luini appears in the Cha-R base and offers to help the Brigade destroy the world. Phinks and Feitan greet his words with disgust before Nobunaga kills him. Phinks then announces that the Brigade will destroy the Heil-Ly while keeping Hisoka as their main priority.

In Tier 3, Phinks, Feitan and Nobunaga explore the neighboring rooms of room 3101 to figure out the teleportation trap. They use hostages to verify its continued triggering and debate the respective roles of Emission, Materialization and possible Specialization.

Hinrigh suggests they swallow a transmitter transformed into an oyster and escapes the trap himself. Phinks receives the detector and tracks its signal with Feitan. He recognizes that his En is too unstable in a crowd: voices, movements and his own movement interrupt his concentration, which limits him to small spaces like a warehouse.

The signal allows the group to conclude that the Heil-Ly hideout is on Tier 2. Nobunaga joins them and then insists on securing a path to the upper floors. Phinks reminds him that the mafia war remains secondary to Hisoka, even if they ultimately accept the official request to destroy the Heil-Ly.

Memories from Meteor City show Phinks as a child, close to Feitan and the future founders of the Brigade. He steals a tape from Chrollo, participates in the Power Cleaners' dubbing as Blue Cleaner, helps search for Sarasa, witnesses the discovery of her body, and supports Chrollo's appointment as leader of the group dedicated to avenging her.

On the twelfth day, Tajao leads Phinks, Feitan and Nobunaga into a secret tunnel. They reach a huge purification and recycling chamber between Tiers 4 and 5. Phinks understands that Heil-Ly may have replaced waste processing contractors to freely lure and kill victims. Nobunaga turns back, while Phinks and Feitan prepare to continue the infiltration.
abilitiesAndPowers: Phinks is one of the Phantom Troupe's major physical fighters. He possesses exceptional strength, speed, and reflexes, as well as a solid theoretical understanding of Nen, including teleportation abilities, marking, materialized spaces, and restricted contracts. Direct and aggressive, he is nevertheless cautious of traps and quickly analyzes crime scenes and opposing tactics.

nen.overview: Phinks is presented as an Enhancer mastering a wide range of techniques. His En works in small spaces but disintegrates when he moves, hears a voice, or senses movement, making him dangerous to use in a crowd.
nen.combatProficiency: Ripper Cyclotron accumulates aura in his fist with each rotation of his arm. Fifteen rounds pulverized a resistant Chimera Ant, although Phinks estimates that half would have been enough and admits to having difficulty measuring its strength.

biography: Kalluto boards the Black Whale with the Phantom Troupe and participates in the search for Hisoka. On the fourth day, all the Spiders gather in the central mess hall of Tier 5 and conclude that their target is probably not on this level.

When members of the Cha-R demand their table, the Brigade withdraws without a fight. Chrollo orders everyone to act freely and return with Hisoka's head, then Kalluto leaves the dining hall with the other members.

Shortly after, Kalluto and Illumi are in the Tier 3 scenic area when a military unit surrounds them following an alert about a dangerous stowaway. Kalluto claims they were sleeping and did not hear the announcement. Mizuri discovers a VVIP ID on Illumi and insists on escorting them.

Mizaistom and Botobai interrupt the exchange. Asked about the presence of the Brigade, Illumi bluntly confirms that it is on board and implies that he is a member, which surprises Kalluto. Mizaistom assigns them residential units in Tier 3, then entrusts their supervision to Botobai and Ginta when an emergency forces him to leave.

The following days, Phinks contacts the other Spiders during the hunt for Luini. On the tenth day, the mafia gradually authorizes the Brigade to search Tier 4, but the precise position of Kalluto after his escort remains unknown.
abilitiesAndPowers: Trained as an assassin for the Zoldyck family and admitted to the Phantom Troupe at a young age, Kalluto is already a notable Nen user despite considering himself the weakest member of the group. His Zetsu is almost perfect, to the point of impressing Hisoka, and his Shu allows his fan to cut through a steel cable. He fights with grace, conceals his espionage techniques even from Spiders, and manipulates large quantities of paper with precision.

equipment.name: Paper fan
equipment.description: Fan used to guide Nen's confetti and as a cutting weapon. Empowered with Shu, it can cut a steel cable.

nen.overview: Kalluto is an Emission-oriented Manipulator. He controls confetti and paper dolls for espionage or attack purposes; the papers could be materialized, but they can also be concealed in one's clothing.
nen.combatProficiency: His Zetsu is described as perfect. In combat, it marks its target with a fragment then gathers the other papers into a piercing snake capable of gradually shredding a Chimera Ant.

description: Founding member of the Phantom and Transmuter Brigade. She searches for Hisoka from a standard cabin in Tier 5 after witnessing his resurrection.
biography: After the duel between Chrollo and Hisoka at the Celestial Tower, Machi remains with the body with Shalnark and Kortopi. The two men leave after confirming the death, but she remains to repair the corpse, Hisoka having paid for the service in advance. She also thanks him for helping to exorcise Chrollo.

As Machi prepares her sons, the aura suddenly surrounds the body. She immediately recognizes a post-mortem Nen: Bungee Gum compresses Hisoka's heart and lungs until resuscitating him. Machi advises him to choose his battles from now on and offers to stitch him up, but he reconstructs his face and limbs himself with Bungee Gum and Texture Surprise.

Hisoka then immobilizes Machi with his aura and orders him to announce to the Spiders that he will now attack them on sight until he has killed them all. Furious, Machi promises to kill him and tries to free herself, becoming one of the first people to learn of her new hunting rules.

On the second day of the trip, she finds Chrollo in a crowded market in Tier 5. She claims the right to kill Hisoka, but Chrollo refuses her priority like a coin toss: this time, all the members of the Brigade want the same revenge. He simply orders him to find their target, who he knows is present on the ship.

On the fourth day, Machi attends the general meeting in the central dining hall. After the peaceful departure of the table claimed by the Cha-R, Chrollo disperses the Spiders and asks them to bring back Hisoka's head. An overview then shows her alone in a standard Tier 5 cabin.

The other members contact her during the hunt for Luini and the advance against the Heil-Ly. On the twelfth day, Phinks asks the Cha-R officials to warn all Spiders of the official deal to destroy Morena's family, but Machi has not yet been directly seen again.

Memories from Meteor City show that as a child, Machi could already perceive aura before any formal awakening to Nen. After Sarasa's death, she witnessed the formation of the group that would become the Phantom Troupe and subsequently developed her exceptional talent for transforming her aura into sons.
abilitiesAndPowers: Machi is an elite assassin, extremely fast fighter and founding member of the Brigade. His intuition is said to be remarkable and his reflexes allow him to sense almost instantly any disturbance in his sons. It combines physical strength, medical expertise and great precision: its sutures can reconnect the muscles, nerves, vessels and bones of a severed limb in just a few moments.

nen.overview: Machi transforms her aura into almost indestructible threads. She already possessed the ability to see aura during her childhood and has mastered Hatsu, In, Ren and Gyo, as well as probably Ten and Ken. She can keep her sons at a distance thanks to the Emission.
nen.combatProficiency: The strength of a thread is inversely proportional to its length: a thread of less than a meter can lift a ton, while a thread long enough to encircle the Earth would not exceed the resistance of cotton. Their strength also diminishes when they leave his fingers.
